title.zh: 卷一百六十五 志第一百十八 職官五
title.raw: 卷一百六十五 志第一百十八 職官五 Volume 165 Treatises 118: Offical Posts 5

sentences.zh: 職官五

translations.literal: Official Posts 5
translations.idiomatic: Official Posts, Part Five

sentences.zh: ○大理寺鴻臚寺司農寺太府寺國子監少府監將作監軍器監都水監司天監

translations.literal: ○ Court of Judicial Review, State Ceremonial Bureau, Court of the National Granaries, Court of the Imperial Treasury, Imperial Academy, Directorate for Imperial Manufacturers, Directorate of Imperial Construction, Directorate for Arms, Directorate of Waterways, Directorate of Astronomy
translations.idiomatic: ○ The Court of Judicial Review; the State Ceremonial Bureau; the Court of the National Granaries; the Court of the Imperial Treasury; the Imperial Academy; the Directorate for Imperial Manufacturers; the Directorate of Imperial Construction; the Directorate for Arms; the Directorate of Waterways; and the Directorate of Astronomy

sentences.zh: 【大理寺】舊置判寺一人，兼少卿事一人。

translations.literal: [Court of Judicial Review] Formerly one court-adjudicator was established, who also handled the duties of a vice-director.
translations.idiomatic: [Court of Judicial Review] The court formerly had one chief adjudicator, who also performed the work of a vice-director.

sentences.zh: 建隆二年，以工部尚書竇儀判寺事。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jianlong, Dou Yi, Minister of Works, was assigned to adjudicate court affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In 962, Dou Yi, Minister of Works, was appointed to preside over the court.

sentences.zh: 凡獄訟之事，隨官司決劾，本寺不復聽訊，但掌斷天下奏獄，送審刑院詳汔，同署以上於朝。

translations.literal: As for all prison litigation, each office decided and impeached as it saw fit; this court no longer heard cases, but only adjudicated memorial prison cases from throughout the realm, sent them to the Office of Reviewing Punishments for detailed review, and jointly signed and submitted them to court.
translations.idiomatic: All litigation was decided by whichever office had jurisdiction; the court no longer held hearings itself. It only ruled on prison cases reported from across the empire, forwarded them to the Office of Reviewing Punishments for thorough review, and jointly signed and submitted the findings at court.

sentences.zh: 詳斷官八人，以京官充，

translations.literal: Eight detailed-adjudication officers, filled by capital officials,
translations.idiomatic: There were eight detailed-adjudication officers, all drawn from the capital bureaucracy,

sentences.zh: 〈（國初，大理正、丞、評事皆有定員，分掌斷獄。

translations.literal: (At the beginning of the dynasty, the Dali rectifiers, assistants, and reviewers all had fixed quotas and divided responsibility for adjudicating cases.
translations.idiomatic: (At the founding of the dynasty, the court's rectifiers, assistants, and reviewers each had fixed quotas and shared responsibility for deciding cases.

sentences.zh: 其後，擇他官明法令者，若常參官則兼正，未常參則兼丞，謂之詳斷官。

translations.literal: Later, other officials versed in statutes were selected; if they were regular attendees at court they also served as rectifiers, if not regular attendees then as assistants—these were called detailed-adjudication officers.
translations.idiomatic: Later, officials from other offices who knew the law were chosen: regular court attendees doubled as rectifiers, and those not in regular attendance doubled as assistants. These posts were called detailed-adjudication officers.

sentences.zh: 舊六人，後加至十一人，又去兼正、丞之名。

translations.literal: Formerly six persons; later increased to eleven, and the titles of concurrent rectifier and assistant were removed.
translations.idiomatic: There had been six such officers; the number was later raised to eleven, and the concurrent titles of rectifier and assistant were dropped.

sentences.zh: 咸平二年始定置。）〉

translations.literal: In the second year of Xianping the posts were first fixed by regulation.)
translations.idiomatic: Their establishment was fixed by regulation in 999.)

sentences.zh: 法直官二人，以幕府、州縣官充，改京官則為檢法官。

translations.literal: Two statute specialists, filled by staff of prefectural offices and district and county officials; if promoted to capital officials they became examining judges.
translations.idiomatic: Two statute specialists were drawn from prefectural staffs and local officials; on promotion to the capital bureaucracy they became examining judges.

sentences.zh: 元豐官制行，置卿一人，少卿二人，正二人，推丞四人，斷丞六人，司直六人，評事十有二人，主簿二人。

translations.literal: When the Yuanfeng bureaucratic system was implemented, one director, two vice-directors, two rectifiers, four investigation assistants, six adjudication assistants, six judicial inspectors, twelve reviewers, and two registrars were established.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuanfeng reforms, the court was staffed with one director, two vice-directors, two rectifiers, four investigation assistants, six adjudication assistants, six judicial inspectors, twelve reviewers, and two registrars.

sentences.zh: 卿掌折獄、詳刑、鞫讞之事。

translations.literal: The director handled matters of deciding cases, reviewing punishments, and inquiring into charges.
translations.idiomatic: The director oversaw case decisions, punishment review, and the examination of charges.

sentences.zh: 同職務分左右：天下奏劾命官、將校及大辟囚以下以疑請讞者，隸左斷刑，則司直、評事詳斷，丞議之，正審之。

translations.literal: The same duties were divided into left and right: throughout the realm, commissioned officials, military officers, and capital offenders and below who submitted doubtful cases for judgment belonged to the Left Division for Adjudicating Punishments; then judicial inspectors and reviewers made detailed rulings, assistants deliberated, and rectifiers reviewed.
translations.idiomatic: The same duties were split into left and right branches. Cases from across the empire—impeachments of commissioned officials and officers, and capital offenders and below who sought judgment on doubtful points—fell to the Left Division for Adjudicating Punishments. Judicial inspectors and reviewers made detailed rulings, assistants deliberated, and rectifiers conducted final review.

sentences.zh: 若在京百司事當推治或特旨委勘及係官之物應追究者，隸右治獄，則丞專推鞫。

translations.literal: If matters of the capital hundred offices required investigation, or special edicts commissioned inquiry, or official property that should be pursued, these belonged to the Right Division for Managing Prisons, and assistants exclusively conducted investigation and interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: Matters of the capital offices requiring investigation, cases specially commissioned by edict, and official property subject to recovery belonged to the Right Division for Managing Prisons, where assistants conducted investigation and interrogation.

sentences.zh: 蓋少卿分領其事，而卿總焉。

translations.literal: The vice-directors respectively led these matters, while the director had overall charge.
translations.idiomatic: The vice-directors each headed one branch, while the director held overall authority.

sentences.zh: 凡刑獄應審議者，上刑部。

translations.literal: All criminal cases requiring deliberation were submitted to the Ministry of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: All criminal cases requiring deliberation were referred to the Ministry of Justice.

sentences.zh: 被旨推鞫及情犯重者，卿同所隸官請封奏裁。

translations.literal: When ordered to investigate and interrogate, or when the offense by circumstance was serious, the director together with the subordinate officials requested sealed memorials for imperial decision.
translations.idiomatic: When cases were ordered for investigation or the offense was grave, the director and the officials under him submitted sealed memorials for the throne's decision.

sentences.zh: 若獄空或斷絕，則御史按實以聞。

translations.literal: If the prisons were empty or adjudication was cut off, the censorate verified the facts and reported.
translations.idiomatic: If the prisons stood empty or adjudication ceased, the censorate verified the facts and reported to court.

sentences.zh: 分案十有一，置吏六十有九。

translations.literal: There were eleven case sections, and sixty-nine clerical posts were established.
translations.idiomatic: The court had eleven case sections and sixty-nine clerical posts.

sentences.zh: 先是舊制，大理寺讞天下奏案而不治獄。

translations.literal: Earlier, under the old system, the Court of Judicial Review judged memorial cases from throughout the realm but did not manage prisons.
translations.idiomatic: Under the earlier system, the Court of Judicial Review ruled on cases reported from across the empire but did not run its own prison.

sentences.zh: 熙寧五年，增詳斷官二為十員。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xining, two detailed-adjudication officers were added, making ten posts.
translations.idiomatic: In 1072, two detailed-adjudication officers were added, bringing the total to ten.

sentences.zh: 七年，置詳斷習學官十四，詳覆習學官六。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, fourteen trainee detailed-adjudication officers and six trainee detailed-review officers were established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1074, fourteen trainees in detailed adjudication and six trainees in detailed review were appointed.

sentences.zh: 九年，詔以「京師官寺，凡有獄皆係開封府司錄司及左右軍巡三院，囚逮猥多，難於隔訊，又暑多瘐死，因緣流滯，動涉歲時。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, an edict stated: "In the capital, all offices with prisons are tied to the Kaifeng prefectural recorder's office and the three wards of the Left and Right Military Patrol. Prisoners detained are excessively numerous, making separate interrogation difficult; moreover, in summer many die of suffocation. Because of delays, cases often drag on for a year or more.
translations.idiomatic: In 1076, an edict declared: "In the capital, every office with a prison funnels detainees through the Kaifeng recorder's office and the three military patrol wards. The numbers held are so large that proper separate interrogation is impossible, and in summer many prisoners suffocate. Cases linger and often take more than a year to resolve.

sentences.zh: 稽參故事，宜屬理官，可復置大理獄。」

translations.literal: Consulting precedents, these should belong to the judicial officials; the Dali prison may be re-established."
translations.idiomatic: Precedent shows that such cases should fall to the judicial offices; the Court of Judicial Review's prison should be restored."

sentences.zh: 始命崔臺符爲知卿事，蹇周輔、楊汲爲少卿，各舉丞及檢法官。

translations.literal: Cui Taifu was first appointed to manage director affairs, Jian Zhoufu and Yang Ji as vice-directors; each recommended assistants and examining judges.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Taifu was first appointed acting director, with Jian Zhoufu and Yang Ji as vice-directors; each recommended assistants and examining judges.

sentences.zh: 初，神宗謂國初廢大理獄非是，以問孫洙，洙對合旨，至是，命官起寺，十七日而成。

translations.literal: Earlier, Emperor Shenzong had said that abolishing the Dali prison at the founding of the dynasty was wrong, and asked Sun Zhu; Zhu's reply accorded with the emperor's intent. At this time officials were ordered to rebuild the court, and it was completed in seventeen days.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Emperor Shenzong had said that abolishing the court's prison at the dynasty's founding was a mistake and had questioned Sun Zhu, whose answer matched the emperor's view. Now officials were ordered to rebuild the court, and the work was finished in seventeen days.

sentences.zh: 元豐二年手詔：「大理寺近舉墜典，俾治獄事，推輪規摹，皆以義起，不少寬假，必懷顧忌，稽留弊害，無異前日。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yuanfeng, an autograph edict stated: "The Court of Judicial Review has recently revived fallen institutions and been charged with managing prison affairs. Its investigative standards and models are all raised on principle, with little leniency; officials must harbor scruples, and the delays and harms of detention are no different from before.
translations.idiomatic: In 1079, the emperor wrote in his own hand: "The Court of Judicial Review has lately revived abandoned institutions and been put in charge of prison affairs. Its investigative standards are strict and allow little latitude; officials are bound to hesitate, and the delays and abuses of detention are no better than before.

sentences.zh: 宜依推製院及御史臺例，不供報糾察司。」

translations.literal: It should follow the precedent of the Investigation and Adjudication Office and the Censorate, and not supply reports to the Inspection Office."
translations.idiomatic: It should follow the precedent of the Investigation and Adjudication Office and the Censorate and not file reports with the Inspection Office."

sentences.zh: 三年，詔依舊供報。

translations.literal: In the third year, an edict ordered reporting as before.
translations.idiomatic: In 1080, an edict restored the former reporting requirement.

sentences.zh: 凡官屬依御史臺例，謁有禁。

translations.literal: All officials followed the Censorate precedent; visiting was prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: All court officials were subject, like censors, to restrictions on outside visits.

sentences.zh: 又詔糾察司察訪本寺斷徒以上出入不當者，索案點檢。

translations.literal: It was further ordered that the Inspection Office investigate this court's improper admissions and releases in cases of penal servitude and above, and demand the files for inspection.
translations.idiomatic: The Inspection Office was also ordered to investigate improper admissions and releases in penal-servitude cases and above, and to demand the files for review.

sentences.zh: 五年，詔毋以大理寺官為試官。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, an edict forbade using Court of Judicial Review officials as examination officers.
translations.idiomatic: In 1082, an edict forbade appointing court officials as examination officers.

sentences.zh: 六年，又詔：「凡斷公案，先上正看詳當否，論難改正，簽印注日，然後過議司覆議；

translations.literal: In the sixth year, another edict stated: "For all decided public cases, they are first sent up to the rectifier to examine whether the ruling is appropriate; after debate and correction, signature, seal, and date notation, they then pass to the deliberation office for re-deliberation;
translations.idiomatic: In 1083, another edict ordered: "For every decided case, the ruling is first sent to the rectifier to check whether it is sound; after debate, correction, signature, seal, and dating, it passes to the deliberation office for review;

sentences.zh: 如有批難，具記改正，長貳更加審定，然後判成錄奏。」

translations.literal: if there are objections, these are fully recorded and corrected, the chief and vice officials further examine and fix, and only then is judgment completed and recorded for memorial.
translations.idiomatic: any objections are recorded and corrected, the chief and vice officials conduct a further review, and only then is the judgment finalized and memorialized."

sentences.zh: 又刑部言：「應吏部補授大理寺左斷刑官，先與刑部、大理寺長貳同議可否，然後注擬。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Justice also stated: "For appointments by the Ministry of Personnel to Left Division adjudication officers of the Court of Judicial Review, the Ministry of Justice and the chief and vice officials of the Court of Judicial Review should first jointly discuss whether the candidate is suitable, and only then make the nomination.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Justice also proposed: "Before the Ministry of Personnel appoints Left Division adjudication officers, the Ministry of Justice and the court's chief and vice officials should jointly assess the candidate's fitness, and only then should the appointment proceed.

sentences.zh: 仍取經試得循資以上人充，正闕以丞補，丞闕以評事補。」

translations.literal: Still only persons who had passed examinations and attained qualification for routine promotion and above should fill the posts; vacancies for rectifiers were filled from assistants, and vacancies for assistants from reviewers."
translations.idiomatic: Only candidates who had passed examinations and qualified for routine promotion should be used; rectifier vacancies were to be filled from assistants, and assistant vacancies from reviewers."

sentences.zh: 詔刑部、吏部同著為令。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Ministry of Justice and Ministry of Personnel jointly to codify this as a statute.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the ministries of Justice and Personnel to codify these rules jointly.

sentences.zh: 八年，詔大理寺推斷事應奏及上尚書省者，更不先申本曹。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, an edict ordered that for Court of Judicial Review investigation and adjudication matters that should be memorialized or submitted to the Secretariat, there was no longer a prior report to the home bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In 1085, an edict ruled that court investigations and rulings requiring memorialization or submission to the Secretariat no longer needed prior approval from the home bureau.

sentences.zh: 元祐元年，以右治獄勘斷公事全少，並左右兩推為一司。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanyou, because the Right Division for Managing Prisons had very few cases to investigate and adjudicate, the Left and Right investigation offices were merged into one bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In 1086, because the Right Division had almost no investigative work, the left and right investigation offices were merged into a single bureau.

sentences.zh: 三年，三省請罷右治獄，依三司舊例置推勘檢法官於戶部，從之。

translations.literal: In the third year, the Three Departments requested abolishing the Right Division for Managing Prisons and, following the old precedent of the Three Offices, establishing investigation and examining judges in the Ministry of Revenue; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In 1088, the Three Departments asked to abolish the Right Division and, following the old Three Offices precedent, place investigation and examining judges in the Ministry of Revenue; the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 又詔大理寺並置長貳。

translations.literal: It was further ordered that the Court of Judicial Review establish both chief and vice officials together.
translations.idiomatic: An edict also required that the court always maintain both a chief and a vice director.

sentences.zh: 四年，從刑部請，改本寺條，任大理官失斷徒已上五人或死罪二人，不在選限。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, following the Ministry of Justice's request, this court's regulations were changed: Dali officials who misjudged five or more penal-servitude cases and above, or two capital cases, were not subject to selection restrictions.
translations.idiomatic: In 1089, at the Ministry of Justice's request, the court's rules were revised: officials who misjudged five or more penal-servitude cases, or two capital cases, were exempt from selection restrictions.

sentences.zh: 〈（舊條，失斷徒已上三人或死罪一人。）〉

translations.literal: (Under the old regulation, misjudging three or more penal-servitude cases and above, or one capital case.)
translations.idiomatic: (Under the old rule, the threshold had been three penal-servitude misjudgments or one capital misjudgment.)

sentences.zh: 紹聖元年，詔斷刑獄官依元豐元年選試法。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shaosheng, an edict ordered that adjudication-of-punishment officials follow the selection-examination law of the first year of Yuanfeng.
translations.idiomatic: In 1094, an edict required punishment-adjudication officials to be appointed under the Yuanfeng selection and examination rules of 1078.

sentences.zh: 二年，復置右治獄，置官屬如元豐製。

translations.literal: In the second year, the Right Division for Managing Prisons was re-established, with officials appointed as under the Yuanfeng system.
translations.idiomatic: In 1095, the Right Division was restored with staffing identical to the Yuanfeng arrangement.

sentences.zh: 左右推事有翻異者互送，再有異者，朝廷委官審問，或送御史臺治之。

translations.literal: When left and right investigation matters produced reversed findings, they were mutually transferred; if there were further reversals, the court commissioned officials to examine and question, or sent the case to the Censorate for handling.
translations.idiomatic: When the left and right investigation offices reached conflicting findings, cases were transferred between them; if conflict persisted, the court assigned officials to review the matter or referred it to the Censorate.

sentences.zh: 元符元年，應大理寺、開封府承受內降公事，不得奏請移送。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanfu, for public business received by the Court of Judicial Review and Kaifeng prefecture from internal edicts, memorial requests to transfer were not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In 1098, the court and Kaifeng prefecture were forbidden to memorialize for transfer of cases assigned by internal edict.

sentences.zh: 又詔應奏斷公事，依開封府專條，不許諸處取索。

translations.literal: It was further ordered that for public business requiring memorialized adjudication, following Kaifeng's special regulations, other offices were not permitted to demand the files.
translations.idiomatic: Memorialized adjudication cases were also placed under Kaifeng's special rules, and other offices were forbidden to demand the files.

sentences.zh: 崇寧四年，詔大理寺官諸司輒奏辟者，以違制論。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Chongning, an edict stated that if various offices rashly memorialized to recruit Court of Judicial Review officials, this was to be prosecuted as violation of regulations.
translations.idiomatic: In 1105, an edict declared that any office that memorialized to poach court officials would be prosecuted for violating regulations.

sentences.zh: 政和二年，詔法官任滿，擇職事修舉、人材可錄者奏舉再任，仍許就任關升，理本等資序。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhenghe, an edict ordered that when judicial officials completed their terms, those whose duties had been well performed and whose talent was worth recording were memorialized for reappointment; they were still permitted promotion in place, reckoned according to their original rank sequence.
translations.idiomatic: In 1112, when judicial officials completed their terms, those who had performed well and showed merit were recommended for reappointment and allowed in-place promotion at their proper rank.

sentences.zh: 五年，依熙、豐故事，復置習學公事四員，長、貳立課程，正、丞同指教。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, following Xining and Yuanfeng precedent, four trainee public-business posts were re-established; the chief and vice officials set the curriculum, and rectifiers and assistants jointly instructed.
translations.idiomatic: In 1115, following Xining and Yuanfeng precedent, four trainee posts were restored; the chief and vice directors set the curriculum, and rectifiers and assistants taught together.

sentences.zh: 宣和七年，評事以上並差試中刑法人。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Xuanhe, reviewers and above were all assigned from those who had passed the penal-law examination.
translations.idiomatic: In 1125, all reviewers and higher posts were filled from candidates who had passed the penal-law examination.

sentences.zh: 又詔大理寺、開封府承受公事依法斷遣，不得乞降特旨。

translations.literal: It was further ordered that the Court of Judicial Review and Kaifeng prefecture, in handling public business, decide and dispose according to law, and not beg for special edicts.
translations.idiomatic: The court and Kaifeng prefecture were also ordered to decide cases according to law and not seek special imperial edicts.

sentences.zh: 中興並省官寺，惟大理寺不並。

translations.literal: At the Restoration, official courts were merged and reduced, but only the Court of Judicial Review was not merged.
translations.idiomatic: After the Restoration, government courts were consolidated, but the Court of Judicial Review alone was left intact.

sentences.zh: 紹興初，詔正與丞並堂除。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shaoxing, an edict ordered that rectifiers and assistants alike be appointed by court selection.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Shaoxing era, rectifiers and assistants were both appointed by direct court selection.

sentences.zh: 評事闕，則委本寺長、貳選擇應格人赴刑部議定，申朝廷差填。

translations.literal: When reviewer posts were vacant, the court's chief and vice officials were entrusted to select qualified persons, send them to the Ministry of Justice for deliberation and decision, and memorialize the court for assignment.
translations.idiomatic: When reviewer posts fell vacant, the chief and vice directors chose qualified candidates, sent them to the Ministry of Justice for approval, and memorialized the throne for appointment.

sentences.zh: 如無應格，即選諳習刑法人權充。

translations.literal: If there were none qualified, then persons versed in penal law were chosen to serve provisionally.
translations.idiomatic: If no qualified candidate was available, someone versed in penal law was appointed acting reviewer.

sentences.zh: 又立比較法以懲差失。

translations.literal: A comparative-assessment law was also established to punish errors.
translations.idiomatic: A comparative-assessment system was also introduced to penalize mistakes.

sentences.zh: 隆興二年，評事鞏衍言：「評事檢斷，躬自節案。

translations.literal: In the second year of Longxing, reviewer Gong Yan stated: "In examining and adjudicating, reviewers personally abridge the case files.
translations.idiomatic: In 1164, reviewer Gong Yan reported: "In examining and ruling on cases, reviewers personally abridge the dossiers.

sentences.zh: 親書斷語，最為勞若。」

translations.literal: They personally write the judgment language—this is the most laborious task."
translations.idiomatic: They personally draft the judgment language, which is the most arduous part of the work."

sentences.zh: 詔增置，以八員為額。

translations.literal: An edict ordered additions, fixing the quota at eight posts.
translations.idiomatic: An edict increased the staff, fixing the quota at eight reviewers.

sentences.zh: 淳熙末，嚴寺官出謁之禁，以防請托、漏泄之弊。

translations.literal: At the end of Chunxi, the prohibition on court officials going out to pay calls was tightened, to guard against the abuses of solicitation and leakage.
translations.idiomatic: Late in the Chunxi era, restrictions on court officials' outside visits were tightened to prevent lobbying and leaks.

sentences.zh: 紹熙初，除試中刑法評事八員外，司直、主簿選用有出身曾曆任人，各兼評事係銜。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shaoxi, apart from the eight reviewers who had passed the penal-law examination, judicial inspectors and registrars were selected from persons with examination backgrounds who had served in office, each concurrently holding reviewer titular rank.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Shaoxi era, aside from the eight reviewers who had passed the penal-law examination, judicial inspectors and registrars were drawn from degree-holders with prior service, each also holding reviewer titular rank.

sentences.zh: 將八評事已擬斷文字，分兩廳點檢。

translations.literal: The draft judgment texts already prepared by the eight reviewers were divided between two halls for checking.
translations.idiomatic: Draft judgments prepared by the eight reviewers were split between two halls for review.

sentences.zh: 或有未安，則述所見與長、貳商量。

translations.literal: If anything was unsatisfactory, they stated their views and consulted with the chief and vice officials.
translations.idiomatic: If anything seemed unsound, they stated their views and consulted the chief and vice directors.

sentences.zh: 慶元四年，定逐委仲月定日斷絕之法。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Qingyuan, a law was fixed that each assigned case must be concluded on a set day in the middle month.
translations.idiomatic: In 1198, a rule fixed the middle day of each month as the deadline for concluding assigned cases.

sentences.zh: 嘉定八年，申嚴紹熙指揮，重司直、主簿之選，增選試取人數以勸法科。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Jiading, Shaoxi directives were re-enforced, weight was placed on selecting judicial inspectors and registrars, and the number admitted by selection examination was increased to encourage the penal-law specialty.
translations.idiomatic: In 1215, Shaoxi rules were re-enforced, greater care was taken in appointing judicial inspectors and registrars, and more examination places were opened to encourage study of penal law.

sentences.zh: 左斷刑分案三：曰磨勘，掌批會吏部等處改官事；

translations.literal: The Left Division for Adjudicating Punishments had three case sections: called Audit, which handled batch-review of Ministry of Personnel and other offices' rank-change matters;
translations.idiomatic: The Left Division for Adjudicating Punishments had three case sections. The Audit section handled batch reviews of rank changes submitted by the Ministry of Personnel and other offices;

sentences.zh: 曰宣黃，掌凡斷訖命官指揮；

translations.literal: called Imperial Yellow, which handled all directives for commissioned officials after cases were decided;
translations.idiomatic: the Imperial Yellow section handled directives for commissioned officials after cases were concluded;

sentences.zh: 曰分簿，掌行分探諸案文字。

translations.literal: called Distribution Ledger, which handled distributing and searching the documents of various cases.
translations.idiomatic: and the Distribution Ledger section distributed and searched case documents.

sentences.zh: 設司有四：曰表奏議，掌拘催詳斷案八房斷議獄案，兼旬申月奏；

translations.literal: Four bureaus were established: called Memorial Presentation and Deliberation, which supervised and urged the eight detailed-adjudication chambers' deliberation on prison cases, and also made ten-day and monthly reports;
translations.idiomatic: Four bureaus were also established. The Memorial Presentation and Deliberation bureau supervised the eight detailed-adjudication chambers, made ten-day and monthly reports,

sentences.zh: 曰開拆；

translations.literal: called Opening and Unsealing;
translations.idiomatic: the Opening and Unsealing bureau,

sentences.zh: 曰知雜；

translations.literal: called General Affairs;
translations.idiomatic: the General Affairs bureau,

sentences.zh: 曰法司。

translations.literal: called Legal Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: and the Legal Bureau.

sentences.zh: 又有詳斷案八房，專定斷諸路申奏獄案等。

translations.literal: There were also eight detailed-adjudication chambers, which exclusively decided prison cases memorialized from the circuits and the like.
translations.idiomatic: There were also eight detailed-adjudication chambers devoted exclusively to circuit memorials and similar prison cases.

sentences.zh: 又有敕庫，掌收管架閣文書。

translations.literal: There was also an edict archive, which received and kept shelved documents.
translations.idiomatic: An edict archive stored shelved documents.

sentences.zh: 吏額；

translations.literal: Clerical quota:
translations.idiomatic: Clerical quota:

sentences.zh: 胥長一人，胥史三人，胥佐三十人，貼書六人，楷書十四人。

translations.literal: one clerical chief, three clerical scribes, thirty clerical assistants, six document attachers, and fourteen copyists.
translations.idiomatic: one clerical chief, three clerical scribes, thirty clerical assistants, six document attachers, and fourteen copyists.

sentences.zh: 〈（隆興共減七人。）〉

translations.literal: (In Longxing, seven posts were reduced in all.)
translations.idiomatic: (In Longxing, seven posts were cut.)

sentences.zh: 右治獄分案有四：曰左右寺案，掌斷訖公事案後收理追贓等；

translations.literal: The Right Division for Managing Prisons had four case sections: called Left and Right Court Cases, which after public cases were decided handled recovery of stolen goods and the like;
translations.idiomatic: The Right Division for Managing Prisons had four case sections. The Left and Right Court Cases section, after cases were decided, handled recovery of stolen goods and related matters;

sentences.zh: 曰驅磨，掌驅磨兩推官錢、官物、文書；

translations.literal: called Audit and Verification, which audited the funds, official goods, and documents of the two investigation officers;
translations.idiomatic: the Audit and Verification section audited funds, official goods, and documents of the two investigation offices;

sentences.zh: 曰檢法，掌檢斷左右推獄案並供檢應用條法；

translations.literal: called Statute Examination, which examined and adjudicated left and right investigation prison cases and supplied applicable statutory provisions for examination;
translations.idiomatic: the Statute Examination section reviewed investigation cases and supplied applicable statutory provisions;

sentences.zh: 曰知雜。

translations.literal: called General Affairs;
translations.idiomatic: the General Affairs bureau,

sentences.zh: 又有開拆、表奏二司；

translations.literal: There were also the Opening and Unsealing and Memorial Presentation bureaus;
translations.idiomatic: It also had Opening and Unsealing and Memorial Presentation bureaus;

sentences.zh: 有左右推，主鞫勘諸處送下公事及定奪等。

translations.literal: and Left and Right Investigation offices, which chiefly interrogated and investigated public business sent down from various places and made determinations.
translations.idiomatic: and left and right investigation offices that interrogated cases sent from other offices and made final determinations.

sentences.zh: 吏額；

translations.literal: Clerical quota:
translations.idiomatic: Clerical quota:

sentences.zh: 前司胥史一人、胥佐九人，表奏司一人、貼書三人，左右推胥史二人、胥佐八人、般押推司四人、貼書四人。

translations.literal: for the front bureau one clerical scribe and nine clerical assistants; for the Memorial Presentation bureau one person and three document attachers; for Left and Right Investigation two clerical scribes, eight clerical assistants, four transport-and-escort investigation clerks, and four document attachers.
translations.idiomatic: for the front bureau, one clerical scribe and nine assistants; for Memorial Presentation, one officer and three document attachers; for left and right investigation, two clerical scribes, eight assistants, four transport clerks, and four document attachers.

sentences.zh: 〈（隆興共減五人。）〉

translations.literal: (In Longxing, five posts were reduced in all.)
translations.idiomatic: (In Longxing, five posts were cut.)

sentences.zh: 【鴻臚寺】舊置判寺事一人，以朝官以上充。

translations.literal: [State Ceremonial Bureau] Formerly one post of court-adjudicator was established, filled by court officials of rank and above.
translations.idiomatic: [State Ceremonial Bureau] The bureau formerly had one chief commissioner, filled by a capital official of appropriate rank.

sentences.zh: 元豐官制行，置卿一人，少卿一人，丞、主簿各一人。

translations.literal: When the Yuanfeng bureaucratic system was implemented, one director, one vice-director, and one assistant and one registrar each were established.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuanfeng reforms, the bureau was staffed with one director, one vice-director, one assistant, and one registrar.

sentences.zh: 卿掌四夷朝貢、宴勞、給賜、送迎之事，及國之凶儀、中都祠廟、道釋籍帳除附之禁令，少卿為之貳，丞參領之。

translations.literal: The director handled the affairs of the four barbarians' tribute missions, banquets in their honor, grants, and escort; also state mourning rites, capital shrines and temples, and prohibitions on adding or removing entries in Buddhist and Daoist registers—the vice-director was second to him, and the assistant shared in leading.
translations.idiomatic: The director oversaw foreign tribute missions, banquets, grants, and ceremonial reception; state mourning rites; capital shrines and temples; and rules governing additions to Buddhist and Daoist registers. The vice-director assisted him, and the assistant shared administrative leadership.

sentences.zh: 凡四夷君長、使價朝見，辨其等位，以賓禮待之，授以館舍而頒其見辭、賜予、宴設之式，戒有司先期辦具；

translations.literal: Whenever barbarian rulers or envoys came to court audience, their ranks were distinguished and they were received with guest ritual; lodgings were assigned and the forms for audience, leave-taking, grants, and banquets were issued, with orders to the relevant offices to prepare everything in advance;
translations.idiomatic: When foreign rulers or envoys came for audience, their rank was determined and they were received with guest ritual. Lodgings were assigned, and the forms for audience, leave-taking, grants, and banquets were issued, with orders to relevant offices to prepare everything in advance;

sentences.zh: 有貢物，則具其數報四方館，引見以進。

translations.literal: if there were tribute goods, their numbers were listed and reported to the Four Quarters Hostel, and the envoys were led in audience to present them.
translations.idiomatic: if tribute goods were presented, their quantities were reported to the Four Quarters Hostel and the envoys were led in to present them at court.

sentences.zh: 諸蕃封冊，即行其禮命。

translations.literal: For enfeoffment patents of the various barbarians, the ritual commands were carried out.
translations.idiomatic: For enfeoffment patents issued to foreign rulers, the bureau carried out the prescribed ritual commands.

sentences.zh: 若崇義公承襲，則辨其嫡庶，具名上尚書省。

translations.literal: If the Duke of Chongyi succeeded to his title, the legitimate and secondary lines were distinguished and the names submitted to the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: When the Duke of Chongyi title was inherited, legitimacy of succession was determined and the names were submitted to the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 其周嵩、慶、懿陵廟，命官以時致享，若凶儀之節，宗室以服，臣僚以品，辨其喪紀而詔奠臨賻贈之制。

translations.literal: For the temples of the Zhou, Song, and Yi imperial tombs, commissioned officials made seasonal offerings; for mourning rites, imperial clansmen by mourning garment and officials by rank were distinguished, and regulations for imperial condolence visits and funeral gifts were proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: For the Zhou, Song, and Yi imperial tomb temples, commissioned officials made seasonal offerings. For mourning ceremonies, imperial clansmen and officials were classified by mourning garment and rank, and rules for imperial condolence visits and funeral gifts were proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 禮儀成服，則卿掌讚導之儀，葬則預戒有司具鹵簿儀物。

translations.literal: When ritual observances and mourning garments were completed, the director managed the guiding rites; for burial, relevant offices were warned in advance to prepare the funeral procession and ritual objects.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning rites were complete, the director guided the ceremonial proceedings; for burials, relevant offices were ordered in advance to prepare the funeral procession and ritual objects.

sentences.zh: 分案四，置吏九。

translations.literal: There were four case sections and nine clerical posts.
translations.idiomatic: The bureau had four case sections and nine clerical posts.

sentences.zh: 其官屬十有二：往來國信所，掌大遼使介交聘之事。

translations.literal: Its subordinate offices numbered twelve: the Incoming and Outgoing State Credentials Office, which handled Liao envoy missions and diplomatic exchanges;
translations.idiomatic: It had twelve subordinate offices. The Incoming and Outgoing State Credentials Office handled Liao envoy missions and diplomatic exchanges;

sentences.zh: 都亭西驛及管幹所，掌河西蕃部貢奉之事。

translations.literal: the Duting West Hostel and its management office, which handled tribute from the Hexi tribal peoples;
translations.idiomatic: the Duting West Hostel and its management office handled tribute from Hexi tribal peoples;

sentences.zh: 禮賓院，掌回鶻、吐蕃、党項、女真等國朝貢館設，及互市譯語之事。

translations.literal: the Court of Ceremonial Guests, which handled lodging for tribute missions from the Uyghurs, Tibetans, Tanguts, Jurchens, and other states, and interpretation for border markets;
translations.idiomatic: the Court of Ceremonial Guests managed lodging for Uyghur, Tibetan, Tangut, Jurchen, and other tribute missions and provided interpreters for border markets;

sentences.zh: 懷遠驛，掌南蕃交州，西蕃龜茲、大食、于闐、甘、沙、宗哥等國貢奉之事。

translations.literal: the Cherishing the Distant Hostel, which handled tribute from Jiaozhi in the southern barbarians, and from Kucha, Dashi, Khotan, Ganzhou, Shazhou, Zongge, and other western states;
translations.idiomatic: the Cherishing the Distant Hostel handled tribute from Jiaozhi and from Kucha, the Arab lands, Khotan, Ganzhou, Shazhou, Zongge, and other western states;

sentences.zh: 中太一宮、建隆觀等各置提點所，掌殿宇齋宮、器用儀物、陳設錢幣之事。

translations.literal: the Central Supreme Unity Palace, Jianlong Abbey, and others each had oversight offices managing palace halls, fasting palaces, ritual vessels, displays, and monetary offerings;
translations.idiomatic: the Central Supreme Unity Palace, Jianlong Abbey, and similar institutions each had oversight offices managing halls, fasting palaces, ritual vessels, displays, and monetary offerings;

sentences.zh: 在京寺務司及提點所，掌諸寺葺治之事。

translations.literal: the Capital Temple Affairs Office and its oversight offices, which handled repairs of various temples;
translations.idiomatic: the Capital Temple Affairs Office and its oversight offices handled repairs of temples in the capital;

sentences.zh: 傳法院，掌譯經潤文。

translations.literal: the Scripture Transmission Court, which handled translation and polishing of scriptures;
translations.idiomatic: the Scripture Transmission Court translated and polished Buddhist scriptures;

sentences.zh: 左、右街僧錄司，掌寺院僧尼帳籍及僧官補授之事。

translations.literal: the Left and Right Street Monastic Registry Offices, which handled temple monastic registers and appointment of monastic officials;
translations.idiomatic: the Left and Right Street Monastic Registry Offices maintained temple registers and appointed monastic officials;

sentences.zh: 同文館及管勾所，掌高麗使命。

translations.literal: the Hall of Common Script and its management office, which handled Goryeo missions;
translations.idiomatic: the Hall of Common Script and its management office handled Goryeo missions;

sentences.zh: 已上並屬鴻臚寺。

translations.literal: all of the above belonged to the State Ceremonial Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: all of the above fell under the State Ceremonial Bureau.

sentences.zh: 中興後，廢鴻臚不置，並入禮部。

translations.literal: After the Restoration, the State Ceremonial Bureau was abolished and not re-established; its functions were merged into the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: After the Restoration, the bureau was abolished and its functions were merged into the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 【司農寺】舊置判寺事二人，以兩製、朝官以上充；

translations.literal: 【Court of the National Granaries】 Formerly two court-adjudicators were established, filled by drafters of edicts and capital officials of rank and above;
translations.idiomatic: 【Court of the National Granaries】 The court formerly had two chief commissioners, filled by edict drafters and capital officials of appropriate rank;

sentences.zh: 主簿一人，以選人充。

translations.literal: one registrar, filled by a selected appointee.
translations.idiomatic: and one registrar, filled by a selected appointee.

sentences.zh: 掌供藉田九種，大中小祀供豕及蔬果、明房油，與平糶、利農之事。

translations.literal: It handled supplying the nine crops for the sacred field, pigs, fruits, and vegetables for great, medium, and small sacrifices, oil for the bright chamber, and matters of grain price stabilization and benefiting agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: It supplied the nine crops for the sacred field, pigs, fruits, and vegetables for state sacrifices, oil for the bright chamber, and oversaw grain price stabilization and agricultural welfare.

sentences.zh: 元豐官制行，始正職掌，置卿、少卿、丞、主簿各一人。

translations.literal: When the Yuanfeng bureaucratic system was implemented, proper duties were first fixed, with one director, one vice-director, one assistant, and one registrar established.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuanfeng reforms, its proper duties were restored, with one director, one vice-director, one assistant, and one registrar.

sentences.zh: 卿掌分儲委積之政令，總苑囿庫務之事而謹其出納，少卿為之貳，丞參領之。

translations.literal: The director handled policies for distributed storage and accumulated reserves, oversaw parklands and warehouse affairs and carefully managed receipts and disbursements; the vice-director was second to him, and the assistant shared in leading.
translations.idiomatic: The director managed policies for grain storage and reserves, oversaw imperial parks and warehouses, and supervised receipts and disbursements. The vice-director assisted him, and the assistant shared administrative leadership.

sentences.zh: 凡京都官吏祿廩，辨其精粗而為之等；

translations.literal: For all grain rations of capital officials, fineness and coarseness were distinguished and grades set;
translations.idiomatic: Capital officials' grain rations were graded by quality;

sentences.zh: 諸路歲運至京師，遣官閱其名色而分納於倉庚，槁秸則歸諸場，歲具封樁、月具見存之數奏聞；

translations.literal: annual transport from the circuits to the capital was inspected by dispatched officials who checked names and types and distributed intake to granaries, while straw went to the fodder yards; yearly sealed-stock reports and monthly reports of quantities on hand were memorialized;
translations.idiomatic: annual grain shipments from the circuits were inspected, sorted by type, and distributed to granaries, with straw sent to fodder yards; yearly sealed-stock reports and monthly inventory reports were submitted to court;

sentences.zh: 給兵食則進呈糧樣，因出納而受賂刻取者，嚴其禁；

translations.literal: when issuing soldiers' provisions, grain samples were submitted; those who took bribes or made exactions in the course of receipts and disbursements were strictly forbidden;
translations.idiomatic: grain samples were submitted when issuing soldiers' rations, and bribery or exactions during receipts and disbursements were strictly forbidden;

sentences.zh: 有負欠者，計其虧數上於倉部。

translations.literal: if there were deficits, the amount of loss was calculated and reported to the Granary Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: deficits were calculated and reported to the Granary Bureau.

sentences.zh: 凡諸路奏雨雪之闕與過多者皆籍之。

translations.literal: All circuit memorials on shortages or excesses of rain and snow were recorded.
translations.idiomatic: All circuit reports on rain and snow shortages or excesses were recorded.

sentences.zh: 凡苑囿行幸排比及薦饗進禦、頒賜植藏之物，戒有司先期辦具。

translations.literal: For parkland tours, arrangements for imperial visits, offerings presented to the throne, and distribution of planted and stored goods, relevant offices were warned to prepare everything in advance.
translations.idiomatic: For imperial park visits, offerings to the throne, and distribution of stored produce, relevant offices were ordered to prepare everything in advance.

sentences.zh: 造麹糵、儲薪炭以待給用。

translations.literal: Malt and yeast were made and fuel and charcoal stored awaiting supply.
translations.idiomatic: Malt and yeast were produced and fuel and charcoal stored for use.

sentences.zh: 天子親耕藉田，有事於先農，則卿奉耒耜，少卿率屬及庶人以終千畝。

translations.literal: When the Son of Heaven personally plowed the sacred field and performed rites to the First Farmer, the director bore the plow and hoe, and the vice-director led subordinates and commoners to complete the thousand mu.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor personally plowed the sacred field and performed rites to the First Farmer, the director bore the plow and hoe, and the vice-director led staff and commoners to complete the thousand mu.

sentences.zh: 分案六，置吏十有八。

translations.literal: There were six case sections and eighteen clerical posts.
translations.idiomatic: The court had six case sections and eighteen clerical posts.

sentences.zh: 初，熙寧二年，置製置條例司，立常平斂散法，遣諸路提舉官推行之。

translations.literal: Earlier, in the second year of Xining, the Regulatory Reform Office was established, the Ever-Normal accumulation-and-distribution law was created, and circuit promotion commissioners were dispatched to implement it.
translations.idiomatic: In 1069, the Regulatory Reform Office was established, the Ever-Normal grain policy was introduced, and circuit commissioners were dispatched to implement it.

sentences.zh: 三年五月，詔製置司均通天下之財，以常平新法付司農寺，增置丞、簿，而農田水利、免役、保甲等法，悉自司農講行。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the third year, an edict ordered the Regulatory Office to balance and circulate the empire's wealth; the Ever-Normal new law was entrusted to the Court of the National Granaries, with added assistants and registrars, and the laws on farmland and waterworks, exemption from corvée, and baojia organization were all expounded and implemented from this court.
translations.idiomatic: In May 1070, an edict ordered the Regulatory Office to balance the empire's finances. The Ever-Normal policy was assigned to the Court of the National Granaries, which gained additional assistants and registrars and took charge of implementing the farmland, waterworks, corvée exemption, and baojia laws.

sentences.zh: 初以太子中允呂惠卿判司農寺，改同判寺胡宗愈為兼判。

translations.literal: At first Lü Huiqing, Vice Director of the Crown Prince's Household, was assigned to adjudicate the Court of the National Granaries; Hu Zongyu, co-adjudicator of the court, was changed to concurrent adjudicator.
translations.idiomatic: Lü Huiqing was first appointed to head the court, and co-adjudicator Hu Zongyu was made concurrent adjudicator.

sentences.zh: 四年，以御史知雜鄧綰判寺，曾布同判，詔諸路提舉常平官課績，田寺考校升絀，管幹官令提舉司保明，計功賞之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Censor Deng Wan, knowing miscellaneous affairs, was assigned to adjudicate the court, with Zeng Bu as co-adjudicator; an edict ordered that circuit Ever-Normal promotion officials' performance be assessed, the Granary Court examine and rank them for promotion or demotion, and managing officials be certified by the promotion office and rewarded according to merit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1071, Censor Deng Wan was appointed to head the court, with Zeng Bu as co-head. Circuit Ever-Normal commissioners were evaluated for performance, the court ranked them for promotion or demotion, and managing officials were certified and rewarded by merit.

sentences.zh: 六年，以司農間遣屬官出視諸路，力有不給，乃置幹當公事官，以葉康直等四人為之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, because the Granary Court occasionally dispatched subordinate officials to inspect the circuits and its strength was insufficient, managing-public-business officers were established, with Ye Kangzhi and three others appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In 1073, because the court could not adequately inspect the circuits, four managing-public-business officers were appointed, including Ye Kangzhi.

sentences.zh: 七年，本寺言：「所主行農田水利、免役、保甲之法，措置未盡，官吏推行多違法意，欲榜諭官私，使人陳述，有司違法，從寺按察。」

translations.literal: In the seventh year, this court stated: "The farmland and waterworks, corvée exemption, and baojia laws under our charge are not yet fully arranged; officials in implementation often violate the intent of the law. We wish to post notices to officials and private persons so people may state their views; if relevant offices violate the law, the court will investigate."
translations.idiomatic: In 1074, the court reported: "The farmland, waterworks, corvée exemption, and baojia policies are not yet fully implemented, and local officials often violate their intent. We propose posting notices so the public may report violations, which the court will investigate."

sentences.zh: 九年，以幹當公事官所至輒用喜怒，罷之，從熊本請也。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, because managing-public-business officers wherever they went acted on whim and temper, they were abolished, following Xiong Ben's request.
translations.idiomatic: In 1076, the managing-public-business officers were abolished because they abused their authority, following Xiong Ben's request.

sentences.zh: 元豐四年，減丞一，主簿三。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yuanfeng, one assistant and three registrars were reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In 1081, one assistant and three registrars were cut.

sentences.zh: 官制行，寺監不治外事，司農事舊職務悉歸戶部右曹。

translations.literal: When the bureaucratic system was implemented, directorates and courts no longer handled external affairs; the Granary Court's former duties all reverted to the Right Section of the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Under the new bureaucratic system, the court no longer handled external affairs; its former duties reverted to the Right Section of the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 元祐三年，詔司農寺置長、貳。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yuanyou, an edict ordered the Court of the National Granaries to establish chief and vice officials.
translations.idiomatic: In 1088, an edict required the court to maintain chief and vice directors.

sentences.zh: 五年，以本寺主簿兼檢法。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, this court's registrar was made concurrent statute examiner.
translations.idiomatic: In 1090, the court's registrar was also made statute examiner.

sentences.zh: 八年，復置提轄修倉所；

translations.literal: In the eighth year, the Oversight Office for Granary Repair was re-established;
translations.idiomatic: In 1093, the Oversight Office for Granary Repair was restored;

sentences.zh: 紹聖元年，詔罷官屬，以其事歸將作監。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shaosheng, an edict abolished its subordinate offices and returned their affairs to the Directorate of Imperial Construction.
translations.idiomatic: In 1094, its subordinate offices were abolished and their functions transferred to the Directorate of Imperial Construction.

sentences.zh: 四年，罷主簿，添丞一員。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the registrar was abolished and one assistant added.
translations.idiomatic: In 1097, the registrar post was abolished and one assistant added.

sentences.zh: 政和六年，浙西諸州各置排岸一員，從兩浙運副應安道請也。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Zhenghe, each prefecture in western Zhejiang established one berth superintendent, following the request of Ying Andao, transport vice-commissioner of the two Zhe circuits.
translations.idiomatic: In 1116, each prefecture in western Zhejiang appointed one berth superintendent, at the request of Ying Andao, transport vice-commissioner of the two Zhe circuits.

sentences.zh: 所隸官屬凡五十，倉二十有五，掌九穀廩藏之事，以給官吏、軍兵祿食之用。

translations.literal: Subordinate offices numbered fifty in all; twenty-five granaries handled storage of the nine grains to supply grain rations for officials, soldiers, and troops.
translations.idiomatic: It had fifty subordinate offices. Twenty-five granaries stored the nine grains to supply rations for officials and troops.

sentences.zh: 凡綱運受納及封樁支用，月具數以報司農。

translations.literal: For all transport-cord intake and sealed-stock disbursement, monthly figures were compiled and reported to the Granary Court.
translations.idiomatic: Monthly reports on transport intake and sealed-stock disbursements were submitted to the court.

sentences.zh: 草場十有二，掌受京畿芻秸，以給牧監飼秣。

translations.literal: Twelve fodder yards received straw from the capital region to supply the pasture directorates.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve fodder yards received straw from the capital region to supply the pasture directorates.

sentences.zh: 排岸司四，掌水運綱船輸納雇直之事。

translations.literal: Four berth superintendent offices handled hire payments for water-transport cord intake.
translations.idiomatic: Four berth superintendent offices handled hire payments for waterborne grain transport.

sentences.zh: 園苑四：玉津、瑞聖、宜春、瓊林苑，掌種植蔬蒔以待供進，修飭亭宇以備遊幸宴設。

translations.literal: Four parklands: Jade Ford, Auspicious Sage, Pleasant Spring, and Jade Grove Gardens, which cultivated vegetables and plantings for presentation and maintained pavilions for imperial tours and banquets.
translations.idiomatic: Four imperial gardens—Jade Ford, Auspicious Sage, Pleasant Spring, and Jade Grove—cultivated produce for court presentation and maintained pavilions for imperial tours and banquets.

sentences.zh: 下卸司，掌受納綱運。

translations.literal: The Unloading Office received and accepted transport cords.
translations.idiomatic: The Unloading Office received incoming transport shipments.

sentences.zh: 都麹院，掌造麹，以供內酒庫酒醴之用，及出鬻以收其直。

translations.literal: The Metropolitan Malt Office made malt to supply the inner wine stores and also sold it to collect payment.
translations.idiomatic: The Metropolitan Malt Office produced malt for the inner wine stores and sold surplus malt for revenue.

sentences.zh: 水磨務，掌水磑磨麥，以供尚食及內外之用。

translations.literal: The Water Mill Office ground wheat by water mill for the imperial kitchen and internal and external use.
translations.idiomatic: The Water Mill Office ground wheat by water mill for the imperial kitchen and other court needs.

sentences.zh: 內柴炭庫，掌諸薪炭，以給宮城及宿衛班直軍士薪炭席薦之物。

translations.literal: The Inner Fuel and Charcoal Store managed fuel and charcoal to supply the palace city and palace guard units with fuel, charcoal, mats, and straw.
translations.idiomatic: The Inner Fuel and Charcoal Store supplied the palace and guard units with fuel, charcoal, mats, and straw.

sentences.zh: 炭場，掌儲炭以供百司之用。

translations.literal: The Charcoal Yard stored charcoal to supply the hundred offices.
translations.idiomatic: The Charcoal Yard stored charcoal for government offices.

sentences.zh: 建炎三年，罷司農寺，以事務並隸倉部。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jianyan, the Court of the National Granaries was abolished and its affairs merged into the Granary Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In 1129, the court was abolished and its functions merged into the Granary Bureau.

sentences.zh: 紹興三年，復置丞二員。

translations.literal: In the third year of Shaoxing, two assistants were re-established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1133, two assistant posts were restored.

sentences.zh: 凡有合行事務，申戶部施行。

translations.literal: For all matters requiring action, memorials were submitted to the Ministry of Revenue for implementation.
translations.idiomatic: All matters requiring action were submitted to the Ministry of Revenue for implementation.

sentences.zh: 四年，復置寺，仍置卿、少。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the court was re-established, with director and vice-director still appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In 1134, the court was restored with director and vice-director.

sentences.zh: 十年，復置簿。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, the registrar was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1140, the registrar post was restored.

sentences.zh: 隆興元年，並省主簿一員。

translations.literal: In the first year of Longxing, one registrar post was cut in the consolidation.
translations.idiomatic: In 1163, one registrar post was cut in the consolidation.

sentences.zh: 明年，詔如舊制。

translations.literal: The next year, an edict restored the old system.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, an edict restored the former staffing.

sentences.zh: 乾道三年，詔糧綱有欠，從本寺斷遣監納，情理重者，大理寺推勘。

translations.literal: In the third year of Qiandao, an edict ordered that when grain transport cords had deficits, this court decided and dispatched supervised payment; in serious cases, the Court of Judicial Review investigated.
translations.idiomatic: In 1167, when grain shipments showed deficits, the court ordered supervised repayment; serious cases were referred to the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 分案五，南北省倉、草料場、和糴場隸焉。

translations.literal: There were five case sections; the northern and southern provincial granaries, fodder yards, and harmonized-purchase yards were subordinate.
translations.idiomatic: It had five case sections overseeing the northern and southern provincial granaries, fodder yards, and harmonized-purchase yards.

sentences.zh: 監倉官分上、中、下界，司其出納。

translations.literal: Granary supervisors were divided into upper, middle, and lower jurisdictions and managed receipts and disbursements.
translations.idiomatic: Granary supervisors were divided into upper, middle, and lower jurisdictions and managed receipts and disbursements.

sentences.zh: 諸場皆置監官。

translations.literal: All yards had supervising officials.
translations.idiomatic: All yards had supervising officials.

sentences.zh: 外有監門官，交量則有檢察斛麵官，綱運下卸有排岸司官，各分其事以佐本寺。

translations.literal: Externally there were gate supervisors; for delivery and measurement there were grain-inspection officials; for transport unloading there were berth superintendent officials—each divided duties to assist this court.
translations.idiomatic: Gate supervisors, grain-inspection officials for delivery and measurement, and berth superintendent officials for unloading each handled distinct duties to assist the court.

sentences.zh: 豐儲倉所，置監官二員，監門官一員。

translations.literal: At the Abundant Storage Granary Office, two supervising officials and one gate supervisor were established.
translations.idiomatic: The Abundant Storage Granary had two supervising officials and one gate supervisor.

sentences.zh: 初，紹興以上供米餘數，樁管別廩，以為水旱之助，後又增廣收糴，淳熙間，命右司為之提領，後以屬檢正，非奉朝廷指揮不許支撥。

translations.literal: At first, in Shaoxing, surplus grain from imperial tribute was sealed in a separate granary as aid against flood and drought; later procurement was expanded. In Chunxi, the Right Office was ordered to oversee it; later it was placed under the Reviewing Rectifier, and disbursement was forbidden except on court order.
translations.idiomatic: Beginning in Shaoxing, surplus tribute grain was stored in a separate granary as a reserve against flood and drought, and procurement was later expanded. In Chunxi, the Right Office oversaw it; later oversight passed to the Reviewing Rectifier, and disbursement required explicit court authorization.

sentences.zh: 別置赤曆，提領官結押，不許袞同司農寺收支經常米數。

translations.literal: A separate red register was kept; the overseeing official sealed it, and mixing with the Granary Court's routine grain receipts and disbursements was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: A separate red register was kept under the overseeing official's seal and could not be commingled with the court's routine grain accounts.

sentences.zh: 凡外州軍起到樁管米，從司農寺差官盤量，據納到數報本所樁管。

translations.literal: For all sealed reserve grain arriving from outer prefectures and armies, officials dispatched by the Granary Court measured and inventoried it and reported the received amount to the reserve office.
translations.idiomatic: Reserve grain arriving from outer prefectures and armies was inventoried by officials dispatched by the court, and received amounts were reported to the reserve office.

sentences.zh: 監官、監門官遇考任滿，所屬批書外，仍於本所批書，視其有無欠折，以定其功過。

translations.literal: When supervising and gate officials completed their terms of evaluation, besides endorsement by their home office, endorsement was also made at this office, judging merit and fault by whether there were deficits.
translations.idiomatic: When supervising and gate officials completed their terms, besides endorsement by their home office, the reserve office also endorsed their records, judging performance by whether deficits occurred.

sentences.zh: 在外，則鎮江、建康亦置倉焉。

translations.literal: Outside the capital, granaries were also established at Zhenjiang and Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Granaries were also established at Zhenjiang and Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 【太府寺】舊置判寺事一人，以兩製或帶職朝官充；

translations.literal: 【Court of the Imperial Treasury】 Formerly one court-adjudicator was established, filled by a drafter of edicts or an incumbent capital official;
translations.idiomatic: 【Court of the Imperial Treasury】 The court formerly had one chief commissioner, filled by an edict drafter or an incumbent capital official;

sentences.zh: 同判寺一人，以京朝官充。

translations.literal: one co-adjudicator, filled by a capital official.
translations.idiomatic: and one co-commissioner, filled by a capital official.

sentences.zh: 凡廩藏貿易、四方貢賦、百官奉給，時皆隸三司，本寺但掌供祠祭香幣、帨巾、神席，及校造斗升衡尺而已。

translations.literal: All granary storage, trade, tribute from the four directions, and officials' salaries at the time belonged to the Three Offices; this court only handled supplying incense and silks for sacrifices, napkins, divine mats, and calibrating pecks, sheng, and measuring rods.
translations.idiomatic: Granary storage, trade, tribute, and official salaries then belonged to the Three Offices; the court only supplied ritual incense and silks, napkins, and divine mats, and calibrated weights and measures.

sentences.zh: 元豐官制行，始正職掌，置卿、少卿各一人，丞、主簿各二人。

translations.literal: When the Yuanfeng bureaucratic system was implemented, proper duties were first fixed, with one director, one vice-director, two assistants, and two registrars established.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuanfeng reforms, its proper duties were restored, with one director, one vice-director, two assistants, and two registrars.

sentences.zh: 卿掌邦國財貨之政令，及庫藏、出納、商稅、平淮、貿易之事，少卿為之貳，丞參領之。

translations.literal: The director handled state policies on wealth and goods, and matters of treasuries, receipts and disbursements, commercial tax, price stabilization, and trade; the vice-director was second to him, and the assistant shared in leading.
translations.idiomatic: The director managed state finance, treasuries, receipts and disbursements, commercial tax, price stabilization, and trade. The vice-director assisted him, and the assistant shared administrative leadership.

sentences.zh: 凡四方貢賦之輸於京師者，辨其名物，視其多寡，別而受之。

translations.literal: For all tribute and taxes from the four directions delivered to the capital, names and goods were distinguished, quantities viewed, and intake separately accepted.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute and taxes delivered to the capital were identified, counted, and accepted separately.

sentences.zh: 儲於內藏者，以待非常之用；

translations.literal: What was stored in the Inner Treasury awaited extraordinary use;
translations.idiomatic: Goods stored in the Inner Treasury were reserved for extraordinary needs;

sentences.zh: 頒於左藏者，以供經常之費。

translations.literal: what was issued to the Left Treasury supplied routine expenses.
translations.idiomatic: goods issued to the Left Treasury supplied routine expenses.

sentences.zh: 凡官吏、軍兵奉祿賜予，以法式頒之，先給曆，從有司檢察，書其名數，鉤覆而後給焉。

translations.literal: For all salaries and grants to officials, soldiers, and troops, they were issued by statutory formula: registers were first given, inspected by relevant offices, names and numbers written, cross-checked, and only then disbursed.
translations.idiomatic: Official and military salaries and grants were issued by statute: registers were prepared, inspected by relevant offices, cross-checked, and only then disbursed.

sentences.zh: 供奉之物，則承旨以進，審奏得晝，乃聽除之。

translations.literal: For tribute goods, they were presented on imperial order, and after memorial review approval in daylight, disbursement was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute goods were presented on imperial order and disbursed only after memorial review and approval.

sentences.zh: 若春秋授軍衣，則前期進樣，定其頒日，畿內將校營兵支請，月具其數以聞。

translations.literal: When spring and autumn military garments were issued, samples were submitted in advance and distribution dates fixed; for generals, officers, and garrison troops within the capital region, monthly figures on requests were compiled and reported.
translations.idiomatic: For spring and autumn military clothing, samples were submitted in advance and distribution dates fixed. Monthly reports on requests from capital-region officers and garrison troops were submitted to court.

sentences.zh: 凡商賈之賦，小賈即門征之，大賈則輸於務。

translations.literal: For all merchants' levies, small merchants were taxed at the gate; large merchants paid at the market office.
translations.idiomatic: Small merchants paid gate taxes; large merchants paid at the market office.

sentences.zh: 貨之不售者，平其價鬻於平淮，乘時賒貸，以濟民用；

translations.literal: Goods that would not sell had their prices stabilized and were sold through the Price-Stabilization Office; timely credit was extended to aid the people's needs;
translations.idiomatic: Unsold goods were sold at stabilized prices through the Price-Stabilization Office, and timely credit was extended to aid the public;

sentences.zh: 若質取於官，則給用多寡，各從其抵。

translations.literal: if pawned with the government, the amount disbursed followed the collateral in each case.
translations.idiomatic: when goods were pawned to the government, disbursements matched the collateral value.

sentences.zh: 歲以香、茶、鹽鈔募人入豆穀實邊。

translations.literal: Each year incense, tea, and salt certificates were used to recruit people to deliver beans and grain to fill the border.
translations.idiomatic: Each year incense, tea, and salt certificates were used to recruit grain deliveries to the border.

sentences.zh: 即京都闕用物，預報度支。

translations.literal: If the capital lacked needed goods, advance report was made to the Department of Budget.
translations.idiomatic: Shortages in the capital were reported in advance to the Department of Budget.

sentences.zh: 凡課入，以盈虧定課最、行賞罰。

translations.literal: For all tax receipts, surplus and deficit determined performance ratings and rewards and punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Tax surpluses and deficits determined performance ratings and rewards and punishments.

sentences.zh: 大祀，晨祼則卿置幣，奠玉則入陳玉帛，餘祀供其帨巾。

translations.literal: At great sacrifices, for the morning libation the director placed the silks; for presenting jade he entered and displayed jade and silks; for other sacrifices he supplied napkins.
translations.idiomatic: At great sacrifices, the director placed silks for the morning libation, presented jade and silks for the jade offering, and supplied napkins for other rites.

sentences.zh: 分案九，置吏六十有五。

translations.literal: There were nine case sections and sixty-five clerical posts.
translations.idiomatic: The court had nine case sections and sixty-five clerical posts.

sentences.zh: 元祐初，以倉部郎官印發文鈔，三年，復歸本寺。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuanyou, Granary Bureau director-level officials issued document certificates; in the third year, this reverted to this court.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Yuanyou, Granary Bureau officials issued document certificates; in 1088, that function reverted to the court.

sentences.zh: 又詔太府置長、貳。

translations.literal: It was further ordered that the Imperial Treasury establish chief and vice officials.
translations.idiomatic: An edict also required the court to maintain chief and vice directors.

sentences.zh: 五年，令長貳每月分巡所轄庫務。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, the chief and vice were ordered to inspect subordinate treasuries monthly in rotation.
translations.idiomatic: In 1090, the chief and vice directors were ordered to inspect subordinate treasuries monthly in rotation.

sentences.zh: 元符元年，增置丞一員。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanfu, one assistant was added.
translations.idiomatic: In 1098, one assistant was added.

sentences.zh: 三年，改市易案為平淮，其市易務亦如之。

translations.literal: In the third year, the Market Exchange section was renamed Price Stabilization, and the Market Exchange offices likewise.
translations.idiomatic: In 1100, the Market Exchange section and offices were renamed Price Stabilization.

sentences.zh: 崇寧中，置藥局七所，添丞一員點檢。

translations.literal: During Chongning, seven medicine bureaus were established and one assistant added for inspection.
translations.idiomatic: During Chongning, seven medicine bureaus were established and one assistant was added to inspect them.

sentences.zh: 宣和三年減罷。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuanhe they were reduced and abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In 1121, they were abolished.

sentences.zh: 靖康元年，詔內外官司局所依熙寧法，錢物並納左藏庫，凡省一百五所。

translations.literal: In the first year of Jingkang, an edict ordered inner and outer government offices and bureaus, following Xining law, to deposit funds and goods in the Left Treasury, abolishing 105 offices in all.
translations.idiomatic: In 1126, an edict ordered all government offices, following Xining practice, to deposit funds in the Left Treasury, abolishing 105 offices in all.

sentences.zh: 又詔戶部、太府寺長貳當職官及本庫官吏俸錢，候在京官吏支散並足，方許支給，從戶部尚書梅執禮之請也。

translations.literal: It was further ordered that salary payments to duty officials of the Ministry of Revenue and Imperial Treasury and to treasury clerks wait until capital officials' disbursements were fully paid, and only then be permitted—following the request of Mei Zhili, Minister of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Salaries for Ministry of Revenue and Treasury officials and treasury clerks were also ordered withheld until capital officials had been fully paid, at the request of Minister of Revenue Mei Zhili.

sentences.zh: 所隸官司二十有五：左藏東西庫，掌受四方財賦之入，以待邦國之經費，給官吏、軍兵奉祿賜予。

translations.literal: Subordinate offices numbered twenty-five: the Eastern and Western Left Treasury stores, which received wealth and taxes from the four directions to await state routine expenses and supply salaries and grants to officials, soldiers, and troops.
translations.idiomatic: It had twenty-five subordinate offices. The Eastern and Western Left Treasury stores received revenue from across the empire for routine state expenses and paid salaries and grants to officials and troops.

sentences.zh: 舊分南北兩庫，政和六年修建新庫，以東西庫為名。

translations.literal: Formerly divided into northern and southern stores; in the sixth year of Zhenghe new stores were built and named the Eastern and Western stores.
translations.idiomatic: They had formerly been divided into northern and southern stores; in 1116 new stores were built and renamed the Eastern and Western stores.

sentences.zh: 西京、南京、北京各置左藏庫、內藏庫，掌受歲計之餘積，以待邦國非常之用。

translations.literal: The Western Capital, Southern Capital, and Northern Capital each had Left Treasury and Inner Treasury stores established, receiving surplus from annual accounts to await extraordinary use by the state.
translations.idiomatic: The Western, Southern, and Northern Capitals each had Left Treasury and Inner Treasury stores that received fiscal surpluses for extraordinary state needs.

sentences.zh: 奉宸庫，掌供內庭，凡金玉、珠寶、良化賄藏焉。

translations.literal: The Imperial Attendance Store supplied the inner court; all gold and jade, pearls and gems, and fine goods and tribute gifts were stored there.
translations.idiomatic: The Imperial Attendance Store supplied the inner court and stored gold, jade, pearls, gems, and other fine goods and tribute gifts.

sentences.zh: 祗候庫，掌受錢帛、器皿、衣服，以備傳詔頒給及殿庭賜予。

translations.literal: The Attendant Service Store received coins and silk, vessels, and clothing to prepare for transmission of edicts, distribution, and hall grants.
translations.idiomatic: The Attendant Service Store received money, silk, vessels, and clothing for edict distribution and palace grants.

sentences.zh: 元豐庫，掌受諸路積剩及常平錢物，凡封樁者皆入焉。

translations.literal: The Yuanfeng Store received route surpluses and Ever-Normal granary funds and goods; all sealed reserves entered it.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuanfeng Store received circuit surpluses and Ever-Normal funds; all sealed reserves were deposited there.

sentences.zh: 〈（神宗常憤契丹倔強，慨然有恢復幽燕之志，聚金帛內帑，自製四言詩一章，曰：「五季失國，獫狁孔熾。

translations.literal: (Emperor Shenzong often resented Khitan stubbornness and, stirred by resolve, cherished the ambition to recover You and Yan. He gathered gold and silk in the inner treasury and himself composed one stanza of four-character verse, saying: "The Five Dynasties lost the realm; the Xianyun ran rampant.
translations.idiomatic: (Emperor Shenzong often resented Khitan intransigence and burned with the ambition to recover You and Yan. He amassed gold and silk in the inner treasury and composed a four-line poem: "The Five Dynasties lost the realm; the northern foe ran rampant.

sentences.zh: 藝祖造邦，思有懲艾。

translations.literal: The Founding Emperor built the state, intending punishment and restraint.
translations.idiomatic: The Founding Emperor built the state, resolved to punish and restrain the foe.

sentences.zh: 爰設內府，基以募士，曾孫保之，敢忘闕誌。」

translations.literal: Thereupon he set up the inner treasury, laying its foundation to recruit warriors; may posterity preserve it—how dare we forget the unfinished task."
translations.idiomatic: He established the inner treasury to fund recruitment of warriors; let posterity guard it—how dare we forget the unfinished mission."

sentences.zh: 每庫以詩一字目之，儲積皆滿。

translations.literal: Each store was titled with one character from the poem, and all stores were filled to capacity.
translations.idiomatic: Each store took one character from the poem as its name, and every store was filled to capacity.

sentences.zh: 又別置庫，賦詩二十字，分揭於庫，曰：「每虔夕惕心，妄意遵遺業，顧予不武姿，何日成戎捷。」

translations.literal: He also set up separate stores, composing a twenty-character poem displayed in sections at the stores, saying: "Each night with reverent vigilance in heart, rashly intending to follow the inherited enterprise; considering my unmartial bearing, on what day shall military victory be achieved?"
translations.idiomatic: He also established separate stores, wrote a twenty-character poem, and posted its lines at each store: "Each night I guard my heart with reverent care, rashly hoping to fulfill the legacy left me; unmartial as I am, on what day shall I win the field?"

sentences.zh: 微宗朝，又有崇寧庫、大觀庫。）〉

translations.literal: In Huizong's reign, there were also Chongning and Daguan stores.)
translations.idiomatic: In Huizong's reign, the Chongning and Daguan stores were also added.)

sentences.zh: 布庫，掌受諸道輸納之布，辨其名物，以待給用。

translations.literal: The Cloth Store received cloth delivered from the circuits, distinguished names and goods, and awaited supply for use.
translations.idiomatic: The Cloth Store received cloth tribute from the circuits, identified each type, and held it for disbursement.

sentences.zh: 茶庫，掌受江、浙、荊湖、建、劍茶茗，以給翰林諸司及賞賚、出鬻。

translations.literal: The Tea Store received tea from Jiang, Zhe, Jing-Hu, Jian, and Jian circuits to supply Hanlin offices and for grants and sale.
translations.idiomatic: The Tea Store received tea from Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Jing-Hu, Jianzhou, and Jiannan for Hanlin offices, grants, and sale.

sentences.zh: 雜物庫，掌受內外雜輸之物，以備支用。

translations.literal: The Miscellaneous Goods Store received miscellaneous tribute goods from within and without to prepare for disbursement.
translations.idiomatic: The Miscellaneous Goods Store received assorted tribute goods from across the empire for routine disbursement.

sentences.zh: 糧料院，掌以法式頒廩祿，凡文武百官、諸司、諸軍奉料，以卷淮給。

translations.literal: The Grain Rations Office, following statutory forms, issued granary stipends; for all civil and military officials, offices, and armies, rations were dispensed according to register rolls.
translations.idiomatic: The Grain Rations Office issued stipends by statute to civil and military officials, offices, and armies, dispensing rations according to register rolls.

sentences.zh: 審計司，掌審其給受之數，以法式驅磨。

translations.literal: The Audit Office examined numbers received and disbursed and audited them by statutory forms.
translations.idiomatic: The Audit Office verified disbursement figures and audited accounts against statutory requirements.

sentences.zh: 都商稅務，掌收京城商旅之算，以輸於左藏。

translations.literal: The Metropolitan Commercial Tax Office collected merchant taxes from the capital and delivered them to the Left Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: The Metropolitan Commercial Tax Office collected merchant taxes in the capital and remitted them to the Left Treasury.

sentences.zh: 汴河上下鎖、蔡河上下鎖，掌舟船木筏之征。

translations.literal: The upper and lower locks of the Bian Canal and the upper and lower locks of the Cai River collected tolls on boats, ships, and rafts.
translations.idiomatic: The Bian and Cai canal locks collected tolls on boats and rafts.

sentences.zh: 都提舉市易司，掌提點貿易貨物，其上下界及諸州市易務、雜買務、雜賣場皆隸焉。

translations.literal: The Metropolitan Market Exchange Office oversaw trade in goods; its upper and lower jurisdictions and market exchange offices, miscellaneous purchase offices, and miscellaneous sales fields in various prefectures were all subordinate.
translations.idiomatic: The Metropolitan Market Exchange Office supervised trade; its upper and lower jurisdictions and the market exchange, purchase, and sales offices in the prefectures were all subordinate to it.

sentences.zh: 市易上界，掌斂市之不售、貨之滯於民用者，乘時貿易，以平百物之直。

translations.literal: The Market Exchange Upper Jurisdiction collected goods unsold in the market and goods stagnant for civilian use, trading at opportune times to stabilize the prices of the hundred commodities.
translations.idiomatic: The Market Exchange Upper Jurisdiction bought unsold and slow-moving goods and traded them opportunely to stabilize market prices.

sentences.zh: 市易下界，掌飛錢給券，以通邊糴。

translations.literal: The Market Exchange Lower Jurisdiction managed flying money and issued coupons to facilitate border grain purchases.
translations.idiomatic: The Market Exchange Lower Jurisdiction issued flying-money coupons to facilitate border grain procurement.

sentences.zh: 雜買務，掌和市百物，凡宮禁、官府所需，以時供納。

translations.literal: The Miscellaneous Purchase Office purchased the hundred commodities in the market and supplied palace precincts and government offices as needed in season.
translations.idiomatic: The Miscellaneous Purchase Office bought goods in the market and supplied the palace and government offices on schedule.

sentences.zh: 雜賣場，掌受內外幣餘之物，計直以待出貨，或淮折支用。
