translations.literal: (Established in the third year of Chongning, recruiting three hundred embroiderers.)
translations.idiomatic: (established in 1104 with three hundred embroiderers recruited.)

sentences.zh: 舊置南郊祭器庫監官二人，太廟祭器法物庫監官二人，掌祠祭器服之名物，各有專典。

translations.literal: Formerly two supervisory officials of the Southern Suburb Sacrificial Vessels Storehouse and two supervisory officials of the Imperial Ancestral Temple Sacrificial Vessels and Ritual Objects Storehouse were established; they managed the names and objects of sacrificial vessels and garments for worship, each with its own specialized regulations.
translations.idiomatic: It formerly had two supervisors for the Southern Suburb sacrificial vessels storehouse and two for the Imperial Ancestral Temple sacrificial vessels and ritual objects storehouse, each with specialized regulations for ritual vessels and vestments.

sentences.zh: 旌節官二人，鑄印篆文官二人。

translations.literal: Two banner-and-staff officials and two seal-casting and seal-script officials.
translations.idiomatic: There were two banner-and-staff officials and two seal-casting and seal-script officials.

sentences.zh: 諸州鑄錢監監官各一人。

translations.literal: Each coin-casting supervisorate in the various prefectures had one supervisory official.
translations.idiomatic: Each prefectural coin-casting office had one supervisor.

sentences.zh: 以上並屬少府監。

translations.literal: All of the above were subordinate to the Directorate for Imperial Manufacturers.
translations.idiomatic: All of the above came under the Directorate for Imperial Manufacturers.

sentences.zh: 【將作監】舊制，判監事一人，以朝官以上充。

translations.literal: 【Directorate of Imperial Construction】 Under the old system, one chief commissioner of the directorate, filled by a court official of sixth rank or above.
translations.idiomatic: 【Directorate of Imperial Construction】 Under the old system there was one chief commissioner, filled by a court official of sixth rank or higher.

sentences.zh: 凡土木工匠之政、京都繕修隸三司修造案，本監但掌祠祀供省牲牌、鎮石、炷香、盥手、焚版幣之事。

translations.literal: All policies for carpentry, masonry, and craftsmen, and capital repairs were subordinate to the Three Departments' Construction Section; this directorate only managed supply for sacrifices of provincial sacrificial-animal plaques, anchor stones, incense lighting, hand-washing, and burning of tablet-offerings and silks.
translations.idiomatic: Policy for builders and craftsmen and capital repairs belonged to the Three Departments' Construction Section; the directorate itself only supplied provincial sacrificial-animal plaques, anchor stones, incense, hand-washing vessels, and tablet-offerings and silks for sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 元豐官制行，始正職掌。

translations.literal: When the Yuanfeng official system was implemented, its proper duties were first restored.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuanfeng reforms its proper functions were at last restored.

sentences.zh: 置監、少監各一人，丞、主簿各二人。

translations.literal: One director and one vice-director were established, and two assistants and two registrars.
translations.idiomatic: It was given one director and one vice-director, two assistants, and two registrars.

sentences.zh: 監掌宮室、城郭、橋梁、舟車營繕之事，少監為之貳，丞參領之，凡土木工匠板築造作之政令總焉。

translations.literal: The director managed palace halls, city walls, bridges, boats, and chariots and matters of construction and repair; the vice-director was second to him, the assistant shared in overseeing affairs, and all policies for carpentry, masonry, craftsmen, rammed earth, and construction were gathered under it.
translations.idiomatic: The director oversaw palaces, walls, bridges, boats, and chariots and all construction and repair; the vice-director assisted him, the assistant shared duties, and all building policy was centralized under the directorate.

sentences.zh: 辨其才幹器物之所須，乘時儲積以待給用，庀其工徒而授以法式；

translations.literal: It distinguished what materials and objects were required, stored supplies in season to await issue, organized artisans and laborers and issued regulations to them;
translations.idiomatic: It determined required materials, stockpiled supplies in season, organized artisans, and issued work regulations;

sentences.zh: 寒暑蚤暮，均其勞逸作止之節。

translations.literal: through cold and heat, early and late, it balanced the seasons of labor and ease, work and rest.
translations.idiomatic: and through heat and cold, dawn and dusk, balanced work and rest.

sentences.zh: 凡營造有計帳，則委官覆視，定其名數，驗實以給之。

translations.literal: Whenever construction had accounting records, officials were delegated to re-inspect, fix names and quantities, verify the actual amounts, and issue supplies accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: When construction accounts were submitted, officials reviewed them, fixed quantities, verified the figures, and issued supplies accordingly.

sentences.zh: 歲以二月治溝渠，通壅塞。

translations.literal: Each year in the second month it cleared drains and channels and opened blockages.
translations.idiomatic: Each year in the second month it cleared drains and channels.

sentences.zh: 乘輿行幸，則預戒有司潔除，均布黃道。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage traveled on tour, it warned the responsible offices in advance to clean and sweep and evenly spread the yellow road.
translations.idiomatic: Before imperial tours it ordered the responsible offices to clean the route and prepare the imperial roadway.

sentences.zh: 凡出納籍帳，歲受而會之，上於工部。

translations.literal: All receipt and issue registers and accounts were received yearly and reconciled, then submitted to the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Receipt and issue accounts were reconciled annually and submitted to the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 熙寧初，以嘉慶院為監，其官屬職事，稽用舊典，已而盡追復之。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xining, the Jiaqing Court served as the directorate; its officials and duties followed the old regulations, but soon all were fully restored.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Xining era the Jiaqing Court served temporarily as headquarters; its staff and duties followed old precedents, but the full establishment was soon restored.

sentences.zh: 元祐七年，詔攽將作監修成《營造法式》八年，又詔本監營造檢計畢，長貳隨事給限，丞、簿覆檢。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yuanyou, an edict ordered the Directorate of Imperial Construction to complete the 《Building Standards》; in the eighth year, another edict stated that when the directorate's construction planning and accounting were finished, the chief and vice chiefs should set deadlines according to each case, and the assistants and registrars should review.
translations.idiomatic: In 1092 an edict ordered the directorate to complete the 《Building Standards》; in 1093 another edict required that once construction plans and accounts were finished, the chief and vice directors set deadlines case by case while assistants and registrars reviewed them.

sentences.zh: 無符元年，三省言：「將作監主簿二員，乞將先到任一員改充幹當公事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Wufu, the Three Departments said: "Of the two registrars of the Directorate of Imperial Construction, I request that the one who arrived first be changed to serve as manager of official business.
translations.idiomatic: In 1098 the Three Departments reported: "Of the directorate's two registrars, we ask that the one with earlier seniority be reassigned as manager of official business.

sentences.zh: 候成資替罷。」

translations.literal: When he becomes fully qualified, he shall be replaced and dismissed."
translations.idiomatic: The post would lapse once he qualified for regular promotion."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 崇寧五年，詔將作監，應承受前後特旨應副外，路並府、監修造差撥人工物料，遵執無豐條格，不得應副。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Chongning, an edict to the Directorate of Imperial Construction stated that apart from complying with special edicts before and after, requests from circuits, prefectures, and sub-directorates for allocation of labor, materials, and goods for construction must follow Yuanfeng regulations and might not be complied with otherwise.
translations.idiomatic: In 1106 the directorate was ordered that apart from special imperial orders, no circuit, prefecture, or sub-directorate request for construction labor or materials could be honored unless it complied with Yuanfeng regulations.

sentences.zh: 宣和五年，詔罷營繕所歸將作監。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Xuanhe, an edict abolished the Construction and Repair Office and returned it to the Directorate of Imperial Construction.
translations.idiomatic: In 1123 the Construction and Repair Office was abolished and its functions restored to the directorate.

sentences.zh: 分案五，置吏二十有七。

translations.literal: There were five sections and twenty-seven clerks.
translations.idiomatic: The directorate had five sections and twenty-seven clerks.

sentences.zh: 所隸官屬十：修內司，掌宮城、太廟繕修之事。

translations.literal: Its subordinate offices numbered ten: the Internal Repairs Office, which managed repair of the palace city and the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
translations.idiomatic: It oversaw ten subordinate offices. The Internal Repairs Office maintained the palace city and the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

sentences.zh: 東西八作司，掌京城內外繕修之事。

translations.literal: The Eastern and Western Eight Works Offices managed repairs inside and outside the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern and Western Eight Works Offices handled repairs inside and outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 竹木務，掌修諸路水運材植及抽算諸河商販竹木，以給內外營造之用。

translations.literal: The Bamboo and Timber Office managed transport of timber by water from the various circuits and the assessment of bamboo and timber sold by merchants on the rivers, to supply inner and outer construction needs.
translations.idiomatic: The Bamboo and Timber Office arranged waterborne timber from the circuits and assessed river trade in bamboo and timber for construction.

sentences.zh: 事材場，掌計度材物，前期樸斫，以給內外營造之用。

translations.literal: The Materials Yard managed calculation of materials, rough-hewing them in advance to supply inner and outer construction needs.
translations.idiomatic: The Materials Yard calculated material needs and rough-cut timber in advance for construction.

sentences.zh: 麥<麥>場，掌受京畿諸縣夏租<麥><麥戈>，以給圬墁之用。

translations.literal: The Wheat Bran Yard managed receipt from the various capital-region counties of summer-tax wheat bran and chaff to supply plastering needs.
translations.idiomatic: The Wheat Bran Yard received summer-tax wheat bran and chaff from capital-region counties for plastering work.

sentences.zh: 窯務，掌陶為磚瓦，以給繕營及瓶缶之器。

translations.literal: The Kiln Office managed pottery-making of bricks and tiles to supply construction and vessels such as jars and pots.
translations.idiomatic: The Kiln Office produced bricks, tiles, and pottery for construction and storage vessels.

sentences.zh: 丹粉所，掌燒變丹粉，以供繪飾。

translations.literal: The Cinnabar and Powder Office managed firing and processing cinnabar and powder to supply painting and ornament.
translations.idiomatic: The Cinnabar and Powder Office processed pigments for painting and decoration.

sentences.zh: 作坊物料庫第三界，掌儲積材物，以備給用。

translations.literal: The Third Division of the Workshop Materials Storehouse managed storage of materials to prepare for issue.
translations.idiomatic: The Third Division of the Workshop Materials Storehouse stockpiled materials for issue.

sentences.zh: 退材場，掌受京城內外退棄材木，掄其長短有差，其曲直中度者以給營造，餘備薪爨。

translations.literal: The Reclaimed Timber Yard managed receipt of discarded timber from inside and outside the capital, sorting it by length and grade; what was straight and met standards was issued for construction, and the remainder was kept for fuel.
translations.idiomatic: The Reclaimed Timber Yard collected discarded timber from the capital, sorted it by size, issued straight usable pieces for construction, and kept the rest for fuel.

sentences.zh: 簾箔場，掌抽算竹木、蒲葦，以供簾箔內外之用。

translations.literal: The Matting and Screen Yard managed assessment of bamboo, timber, and rushes to supply mats, screens, and similar goods for inner and outer use.
translations.idiomatic: The Matting and Screen Yard assessed bamboo, timber, and rushes for mats and screens.

sentences.zh: 建炎三年，詔將作監並歸工部。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jianyan, an edict ordered the Directorate of Imperial Construction transferred altogether to the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In 1129 the directorate was placed under the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 紹興三年，復置丞，仍兼總少府之事。

translations.literal: In the third year of Shaoxing, an assistant was restored and still concurrently oversaw affairs of the Directorate for Imperial Manufacturers.
translations.idiomatic: In 1133 an assistant was restored and also oversaw Directorate for Imperial Manufacturers affairs.

sentences.zh: 十年，置主簿一員。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, one registrar was established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1140 one registrar was appointed.

sentences.zh: 十一年，詔依司農、太府寺，置長、貳一員。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, an edict ordered, following the Court of the National Granaries and the Court of the Imperial Treasury, that one chief and one vice chief be established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1141, following the Courts of the National Granaries and Imperial Treasury, one chief and one vice chief were appointed.

sentences.zh: 隆興初，宮室無所營繕，職務簡省，百工器用屬之文思院，以隸工部；

translations.literal: At the beginning of Longxing, with no palace construction to undertake, duties were simplified; the hundred crafts and implements were assigned to the Literary Refinement Court and subordinated to the Ministry of Works;
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Longxing era, with little palace construction, duties were reduced; craft production was assigned to the Literary Refinement Court under the Ministry of Works;

sentences.zh: 本監惟置丞一員，餘官虛而不除。

translations.literal: this directorate only established one assistant; the remaining posts were left vacant and unfilled.
translations.idiomatic: the directorate kept only one assistant, leaving the other posts unfilled.

sentences.zh: 乾道以後，人材甚多，監、少、丞、簿無闕，凡台省之久次與郡邑之有聲者，悉寄俓於此，自是號為儲才之地，而營繕之事，多俾府尹、畿漕分任其責焉。

translations.literal: After Qiandao, talented men were very numerous; director, vice-director, assistant, and registrar posts were never vacant; all long-serving officials of the central bureaus and men of reputation in prefectures and counties were given nominal assignments here; from this it was styled a place for storing talent, while construction and repair were largely left to the prefectural governors and capital transport commissioners to share the responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: After the Qiandao era the directorate was fully staffed with talented men; senior capital officials and distinguished local officers were given nominal appointments there, and it became known as a talent reserve. Construction and repair were largely delegated to prefectural governors and capital transport commissioners.

sentences.zh: 【軍器監】國初，戎器之職領於三司胄案，官無專職。

translations.literal: 【Directorate for Arms】 At the beginning of the dynasty, duties for military equipment were led by the Three Departments' Armor Section, and there was no specialized office.
translations.idiomatic: 【Directorate for Arms】 Early in the dynasty military equipment was handled by the Three Departments' Armor Section, with no dedicated office.

sentences.zh: 熙寧六年，廢胃案，乃按唐令置監，以從官總判，元豐正名，始置監、少監各一人，丞二人，主簿一人。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Xining, the Armor Section was abolished, and a directorate was then established according to Tang regulations, with a follower-official as overall chief commissioner; in Yuanfeng the proper name was fixed, and one director, one vice-director, two assistants, and one registrar were first established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1073 the Armor Section was abolished and a directorate was established on the Tang model under an overall commissioner; under Yuanfeng it received its formal name and was given one director, one vice-director, two assistants, and one registrar.

sentences.zh: 監掌監督繕治兵器什物，以給軍國之用，少監為之貳，丞參領之。

translations.literal: The director managed supervision of repair and manufacture of weapons and gear to supply military and state needs; the vice-director was second to him, and the assistant shared in overseeing affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The director supervised the manufacture and repair of weapons and equipment for army and state use; the vice-director assisted him, and the assistant shared administrative duties.

sentences.zh: 凡利器以法式授工徒，其弓矢、干戈、甲胄、劍戟戰守之具，因其能而分任之，量用給材，旬會其數以考程課，而輸於武庫，委遣官詣所隸檢察。

translations.literal: All sharp weapons were issued to artisans and laborers by regulation; bows and arrows, shields and halberds, armor and helmets, swords and spears, and equipment for offense and defense were assigned according to their skills; materials were issued in measured amounts; numbers were reconciled every ten days to examine quotas; goods were delivered to the military storehouse; and dispatched officials went to the subordinate offices to inspect.
translations.idiomatic: Artisans received weapon specifications by regulation; bows, shields, armor, swords, and other offensive and defensive gear were assigned by skill; materials were issued as needed; output was tallied every ten days against quotas; finished goods went to the military storehouse; and inspectors were sent to subordinate offices.

sentences.zh: 凡用膠漆、筋革、材物必以時，課百工造作，勞逸必均，歲終閱其良否多寡之數，以詔賞罰。

translations.literal: All use of glue, lacquer, sinew, hides, and materials had to be timely; the hundred crafts were tasked with manufacture; labor and ease had to be balanced; at year's end the numbers of good and bad and many and few were reviewed to decree rewards and punishments.
translations.idiomatic: Glue, lacquer, sinew, hides, and materials had to be used on schedule; artisans were assigned work with balanced labor; and at year's end quality and quantity were reviewed to determine rewards and punishments.

sentences.zh: 器成則進呈便殿，俟閱試而頒其樣式於諸道。

translations.literal: When weapons were completed they were presented in the Convenience Hall; after inspection and testing their models were issued to the various circuits.
translations.idiomatic: Finished weapons were presented in the Convenience Hall; after inspection and testing, their patterns were issued to the circuits.

sentences.zh: 即要會州建都作院分造器械，從本監比較而進退其官吏焉，元祐三年，省丞一員，紹聖中復置。

translations.literal: They also convened the prefectures and capital workshops to divide manufacture of equipment; from this directorate comparisons were made to promote or demote its officials; in the third year of Yuanyou one assistant was reduced; in the Shaosheng period one was restored.
translations.idiomatic: The directorate also coordinated prefectures and capital workshops in divided production and used comparisons to promote or dismiss its officials. One assistant was cut in 1098 and restored during the Shaosheng era.

sentences.zh: 政和三年，應御前軍器監所頒降軍器樣製，非長、貳當職官不得省閱，及傳寫漏泄，論以違制。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhenghe, concerning the armament patterns issued by the Imperial Front Directorate for Arms, no one except the chief and vice chief holding active duty might examine them; copying or leaking them was prosecuted as violation of imperial orders.
translations.idiomatic: In 1113 the armament patterns issued by the Imperial Front Directorate for Arms could be examined only by its chief and vice directors on active duty; unauthorized copying or disclosure was punished as a violation of imperial orders.

sentences.zh: 分案五，置吏十有三，所隸官屬四：東西作坊，掌造兵器、旗幟、戎帳、什物，辨其名色，謹其繕作，以輸於受藏之府，兵校工匠，其役有程，視精粗利鈍以為之賞罰。

translations.literal: There were five sections and thirteen clerks; its subordinate offices numbered four: the Eastern and Western Workshops, which managed manufacture of weapons, banners, military tents, and gear, distinguished their names and colors, carefully supervised their repair and manufacture, and delivered them to the receiving storehouses; military officers and craftsmen had fixed quotas for their service, and rewards and punishments were based on fineness, coarseness, sharpness, and dullness.
translations.idiomatic: The directorate had five sections and thirteen clerks and four subordinate offices. The Eastern and Western Workshops made weapons, banners, military tents, and gear, catalogued types and colors, supervised production, and delivered goods to storehouses. Officers and craftsmen worked to fixed quotas, with rewards and punishments based on workmanship.

sentences.zh: 作坊物料庫，掌收鐵錫、羽箭、油漆之屬。

translations.literal: The Workshop Materials Storehouse managed receipt of iron, tin, feathered arrows, lacquer, paint, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: The Workshop Materials Storehouse stored iron, tin, feathered arrows, lacquer, paint, and similar supplies.

sentences.zh: 皮角場，掌收皮革、筋角，以供作坊之用。

translations.literal: The Hide and Horn Yard managed receipt of hides, leather, sinew, and horn to supply the workshops.
translations.idiomatic: The Hide and Horn Yard collected hides, leather, sinew, and horn for the workshops.

sentences.zh: 南渡置御前軍器所，建炎三年，詔軍器監並歸工部，東西作坊、都作院並入軍器所。

translations.literal: After the southward crossing the Imperial Front Armaments Office was established; in the third year of Jianyan, an edict ordered the Directorate for Arms transferred altogether to the Ministry of Works, and the Eastern and Western Workshops and the Capital Manufactories were all merged into the Armaments Office.
translations.idiomatic: After the court fled south an Imperial Front Armaments Office was established. In 1129 the Directorate for Arms was placed under the Ministry of Works, and the Eastern and Western Workshops and Capital Manufactories were merged into the Armaments Office.

sentences.zh: 紹興三年，復置丞一員，令工部相度合管職事歸之。

translations.literal: In the third year of Shaoxing, one assistant was restored and the Ministry of Works was ordered to assess which duties ought to be managed and return them to it.
translations.idiomatic: In 1133 one assistant was restored and the Ministry of Works was ordered to return appropriate duties to the directorate.

sentences.zh: 十一年，詔復置長、貳各一員。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, an edict restored one chief and one vice chief.
translations.idiomatic: In 1141 one chief and one vice chief were restored.

sentences.zh: 十四年，以朝奉大夫趙子厚守軍器監，宗室為寺監長、貳自此始。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, Grandee for Court Audience Zhao Zihou was appointed to hold the Directorate for Arms; from this imperial clansmen as chiefs and vice chiefs of directorates began.
translations.idiomatic: In 1144 Grandee for Court Audience Zhao Zihou was appointed director; from this appointment imperial clansmen began serving as chiefs and vice chiefs of directorates.

sentences.zh: 隆興初，詔置造軍器，已有軍器所隸工部，本監惟置丞一員。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Longxing, an edict ordered establishment of armament manufacture; since the Armaments Office already was subordinate to the Ministry of Works, this directorate only established one assistant.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Longxing era armament manufacture was assigned to the Armaments Office under the Ministry of Works, and the directorate kept only one assistant.

sentences.zh: 乾道五年，復置少監及簿，六年，以少監韓玉往建康點檢物馬，以奉使軍器少監為名。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Qiandao, the vice-director and registrar were restored; in the sixth year, Vice-Director Han Yu went to Jiankang to inspect supplies and horses, under the title Envoy Vice-Director for Arms on Imperial Mission.
translations.idiomatic: In 1169 the vice-director and registrar were restored; in 1170 Vice-Director Han Yu went to Jiankang to inspect supplies and horses as Envoy Vice-Director for Arms.

sentences.zh: 是年，復置監一員。

translations.literal: In that year, one director was restored.
translations.idiomatic: That same year the director's post was restored.

sentences.zh: 淳熙初元，詔戎器非進入毋輒出所，由是呈驗浸省。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the first year of Chunxi, an edict ordered that weapons not brought in as tribute must not be removed from the depot without authorization; because of this, presentation and inspection were gradually reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Early in 1174, an edict forbade removing weapons from the depot unless they had been formally received as tribute, and presentation and inspection were gradually reduced.

sentences.zh: 二年，錢良臣以少監總領淮東財賦；

translations.literal: In the second year, Qian Liangchen, as vice-director, took overall charge of Huaidong revenue;
translations.idiomatic: In 1175, Vice-Director Qian Liangchen took overall charge of Huaidong revenue;

sentences.zh: 八年，沈揆復以監長行。

translations.literal: in the eighth year, Shen Kui again served in the capacity of director.
translations.idiomatic: and in 1181 Shen Kui again served as acting director.

sentences.zh: 諸監長貳自是始許總餉外帶，然二人實初兼版曹職事。

translations.literal: From this time directors and vice-directors of directorates were first permitted to take overall charge of supplies while holding other posts, but these two men had in fact initially combined duties in the Board of Works.
translations.idiomatic: From then on, directors and vice-directors were allowed to oversee supply while holding other posts, though both men had initially combined Board of Works duties.

sentences.zh: 嘉定十四年，岳珂獨以軍器監總餉淮東。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Jiading, Yue Ke alone, as director of the Directorate for Arms, took overall charge of Huaidong supplies.
translations.idiomatic: In 1221 Yue Ke alone, as director of the Directorate for Arms, took overall charge of Huaidong supplies.

sentences.zh: 是後，戎所、作坊已備官於下，宥府、起部並提綱於上，監居其間，事務稀簡，特為儲才之所焉。

translations.literal: After this, armories and workshops below already had their officials in place, while the Armaments Office and the Construction Bureau above held overall authority; the directorate stood between them, its affairs sparse and simple, and it became especially a place for storing talent.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter armories and workshops below had their own officials, while the Armaments Office and Construction Bureau held authority above. The directorate stood between them with light duties and became chiefly a place to groom talent.

sentences.zh: 【都水監】舊隸三司河渠案，嘉祐三年，始專置監以領之。

translations.literal: 【Directorate of Waterways】 Formerly subordinate to the Three Offices' River Works section; in the third year of Jiayou a separate directorate was first established to oversee it.
translations.idiomatic: 【Directorate of Waterways】 It had formerly belonged to the Three Offices' River Works section; in 1058 a separate directorate was established to oversee waterworks.

sentences.zh: 判監事一人，以員外郎以上充，同判監事一人，以朝官以上充；

translations.literal: one court-adjudicator, filled by an outer-court official of rank and above; one co-adjudicator, filled by a capital official of rank and above;
translations.idiomatic: One chief commissioner, filled by an outer-court official of appropriate rank, and one co-commissioner, filled by a capital official;

sentences.zh: 丞二人，主簿一人，並以京朝官充。

translations.literal: two assistants and one registrar, all filled by capital officials.
translations.idiomatic: two assistants and one registrar, all drawn from the capital bureaucracy.

sentences.zh: 輪遣丞一人出外治河埽之事，或一歲再歲而罷，其有諳知水政，或至三年。

translations.literal: One assistant was dispatched in rotation to manage dike and revetment affairs outside the capital, serving one or two years before relief; those versed in water administration might serve up to three years.
translations.idiomatic: One assistant was rotated out to manage dikes and revetments, usually for one or two years, though experts in water administration might serve up to three.

sentences.zh: 置局於澶州，號曰外監。

translations.literal: An office was established at Dazhou, called the Outer Directorate.
translations.idiomatic: An office was established at Dazhou, called the Outer Directorate.

sentences.zh: 元豐正名，置使者一人，丞二人，主簿一人。

translations.literal: Under Yuanfeng the name was regularized, with one commissioner, two assistants, and one registrar established.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuanfeng reforms the title was regularized, with one commissioner, two assistants, and one registrar.

sentences.zh: 使者掌中外川澤、河渠、津梁、堤堰疏鑿浚治之事，丞參領之。

translations.literal: The commissioner handled matters of rivers, lakes, canals, ferries, bridges, dikes, and dredging and repair throughout the empire; assistants shared in leading.
translations.idiomatic: The commissioner oversaw rivers, lakes, canals, ferries, bridges, dikes, and dredging and repair throughout the empire; assistants shared administrative leadership.

sentences.zh: 凡治水之法，以防止水，以溝蕩水，以澮寫水，以陂池瀦水。

translations.literal: For all methods of managing water: use dikes to hold water back, use ditches to drain it, use channels to conduct it away, and use ponds and reservoirs to store it.
translations.idiomatic: Water was managed by holding it back with dikes, draining it through ditches, conducting it away through channels, and storing it in ponds and reservoirs.

sentences.zh: 凡江、河、淮、海所經郡邑，皆頒其禁令。

translations.literal: For all prefectures and districts through which the Yangzi, Yellow River, Huai, and sea routes passed, its prohibitions were issued.
translations.idiomatic: Its regulations were issued to all prefectures and districts along the Yangzi, Yellow River, Huai, and coastal routes.

sentences.zh: 視汴、洛水勢漲涸增損而調節之。

translations.literal: The rise, fall, increase, and decrease of the Bian and Luo waters were observed and regulated.
translations.idiomatic: The levels of the Bian and Luo rivers were monitored and regulated.

sentences.zh: 凡河防謹其法禁，歲計茭揵之數，前期儲積，以時頒用，各隨其所治地而任其責。

translations.literal: For all river defense its legal prohibitions were strictly observed; yearly quotas of rush and fascine materials were calculated, stockpiled in advance, and issued on schedule, each office bearing responsibility according to the territory it administered.
translations.idiomatic: River defense regulations were strictly enforced. Annual quotas of rush and fascine materials were calculated, stockpiled in advance, and issued on schedule, with each office responsible for its jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 興役以後月至十月止，民功則隨其先後毋過一月，若導水溉田及疏治壅積為民利者，定其賞罰。

translations.literal: Labor service ran from the intercalary month through the tenth month; civilian labor followed priority but did not exceed one month. Where channeling water to irrigate fields or clearing blockages benefited the people, rewards and punishments were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Labor service ran from the intercalary month through the tenth month; civilian labor was limited to one month by priority. Rewards and punishments were set for projects that channeled irrigation water or cleared blockages for public benefit.

sentences.zh: 凡修堤岸、植榆柳，則視其勤惰多寡以為殿最。

translations.literal: For repairing dikes and planting elms and willows, diligence, idleness, and quantity were assessed to determine highest and lowest ratings.
translations.idiomatic: Performance in repairing dikes and planting elms and willows was rated by diligence and output.

sentences.zh: 南、北外都水丞各一人，都提舉官八人，監埽官百三十有五人，皆分職蒞事；

translations.literal: one southern and one northern outer waterways assistant each, eight overall promotion officials, and one hundred thirty-five dike-revetment supervisors—all divided duties and attended to affairs;
translations.idiomatic: There were one southern and one northern outer waterways assistant, eight overall promotion officials, and 135 dike-revetment supervisors, each handling distinct duties;

sentences.zh: 即幹機速，非外丞所能治，則使者行視河渠事。

translations.literal: when urgent matters arose that outer assistants could not handle, the commissioner went out to inspect river and canal affairs.
translations.idiomatic: when urgent matters arose that outer assistants could not handle, the commissioner inspected river and canal affairs in person.

sentences.zh: 元豐八年，詔提舉汴河堤岸司隸本監。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Yuanfeng, an edict ordered the Bian River Dike Office to be subordinated to this directorate.
translations.idiomatic: In 1085 an edict placed the Bian River Dike Office under this directorate.

sentences.zh: 先是，導洛入汴，專置堤岸司。

translations.literal: Earlier, when the Luo was channeled into the Bian, a separate dike office had been established.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when the Luo River was channeled into the Bian, a separate dike office had been established.

sentences.zh: 至是，亦歸之有司。

translations.literal: At this time it too reverted to the relevant offices.
translations.idiomatic: Now it too reverted to the regular bureaucracy.

sentences.zh: 元祐四年，復置外都水使者。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yuanyou, the outer waterways commissioner was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1089 the outer waterways commissioner was restored.

sentences.zh: 五年，詔南、北外都水丞並以三年為任。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, an edict fixed three-year terms for the southern and northern outer waterways assistants.
translations.idiomatic: In 1090 three-year terms were fixed for the southern and northern outer waterways assistants.

sentences.zh: 七年，方議回河東流，乃詔河北、京西漕臣及開封府界提點，各兼南、北外都水事，紹聖元年罷。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, just as the return of the Yellow River to its eastern course was under discussion, transport commissioners of Hebei and Jingxi and the Kaifeng prefectural boundary intendant were each ordered to combine southern and northern outer waterways duties; this was abolished in the first year of Shaosheng.
translations.idiomatic: In 1092, as debate over returning the Yellow River to its eastern course began, Hebei and Jingxi transport commissioners and the Kaifeng boundary intendant were each ordered to combine outer waterways duties; the arrangement was abolished in 1094.

sentences.zh: 元符三年，詔罷北外都水丞，以河事委之漕臣；

translations.literal: In the third year of Yuanfu, an edict abolished the northern outer waterways assistant and entrusted river affairs to transport commissioners;
translations.idiomatic: In 1100 the northern outer waterways assistant was abolished and river affairs entrusted to transport commissioners;

sentences.zh: 三年，復置。

translations.literal: in the third year it was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: and in 1103 the post was restored.

sentences.zh: 重和元年，工部尚書王詔言，乞選差曾任水官諳練者為南、北兩外丞，從之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chonghe, Wang Shao, Minister of Works, requested that experienced former water officials be selected as the southern and northern outer assistants; this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: In 1118 Minister of Works Wang Shao requested that experienced former water officials be appointed as the southern and northern outer assistants; the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 宣和三年，詔罷南、北外都水丞司，依元豐法，通差文武官一員。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuanhe, an edict abolished the southern and northern outer waterways assistant offices and, following Yuanfeng law, assigned one civil or military official in general rotation.
translations.idiomatic: In 1121 the southern and northern outer waterways offices were abolished and, following Yuanfeng practice, one civil or military official was assigned in rotation.

sentences.zh: 分案七，置吏三十有七。

translations.literal: There were seven case sections and thirty-seven clerical posts.
translations.idiomatic: The directorate had seven case sections and thirty-seven clerical posts.

sentences.zh: 所隸有：街道司，掌轄治道路人兵，若車駕行幸，則前期修治，有積水則疏導之。

translations.literal: Subordinate offices included: the Streets Office, which commanded road maintenance troops; when the imperial carriage traveled, repairs were made in advance, and standing water was drained.
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate offices included the Streets Office, which commanded road maintenance troops, made repairs before imperial tours, and drained standing water.

sentences.zh: 建炎三年，詔都水監置使者一員。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jianyan, an edict ordered the Directorate of Waterways to establish one commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 1129 an edict restored one commissioner for the Directorate of Waterways.

sentences.zh: 紹興九年，復置南、北外都水丞各一員，南丞於應天府，北丞於東京置司。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Shaoxing, one southern and one northern outer waterways assistant were re-established; the southern assistant had his office at Yingtian prefecture and the northern at the Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In 1139 southern and northern outer waterways assistants were restored, the southern based at Yingtian prefecture and the northern at the Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 十年，詔都水事歸於工部，不復置官。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, an edict ordered waterways affairs to revert to the Ministry of Works, and the posts were not re-established.
translations.idiomatic: In 1140 waterways affairs reverted to the Ministry of Works and the posts were not restored.

sentences.zh: 【司天監】監少監丞主簿春官正夏官正中官正秋官正冬官正靈台郎保章正挈壺正各一人。

translations.literal: 【Directorate of Astronomy】 One director, one vice-director, assistants, registrar, Director of the Spring Office, Director of the Summer Office, Director of the Center Office, Director of the Autumn Office, Director of the Winter Office, Observatory Officer, Keeper of the Seals, and Clepsydra Officer, one each.
translations.idiomatic: 【Directorate of Astronomy】 The staff comprised one director, one vice-director, assistants, a registrar, the directors of the Spring, Summer, Center, Autumn, and Winter offices, an observatory officer, a keeper of the seals, and a clepsydra officer, one of each.

sentences.zh: 掌察天文祥異，鍾鼓漏刻，寫造曆書，供諸壇祀察告神名版位畫日。

translations.literal: It observed heavenly omens and anomalies, managed bells, drums, and clepsydra markings, drafted calendrical books, and supplied spirit name tablets, positions, and selected dates for altar sacrifices and announcements.
translations.idiomatic: It observed celestial omens, managed bells, drums, and water clocks, drafted calendars, and supplied spirit name tablets, ritual positions, and selected dates for altar sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 監及少監闕，則置判監事二人。

translations.literal: When the director and vice-director posts were vacant, two court-adjudicators were established.
translations.idiomatic: When the director and vice-director posts were vacant, two acting commissioners were appointed.

sentences.zh: 〈（以五官正充。）〉

translations.literal: (filled by the five office directors.)
translations.idiomatic: (filled by the five office directors.)

sentences.zh: 禮生四人，曆生四人，掌測驗渾儀，同知算造三式。

translations.literal: Four ritual clerks and four calendar clerks tested the armillary sphere and jointly managed calculation of the three calendrical systems.
translations.idiomatic: Four ritual clerks and four calendar clerks operated the armillary sphere and jointly calculated the three calendrical systems.

sentences.zh: 元豐官制行，罷司天監，立太史局，隸秘書省。

translations.literal: When the Yuanfeng bureaucratic system was implemented, the Directorate of Astronomy was abolished and the Grand Astrologer Bureau was established, subordinate to the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuanfeng reforms, the Directorate of Astronomy was abolished and the Grand Astrologer Bureau was established under the Secretariat.
